tracks.title: Send It to the Lab
tracks.mood: swaggering, sheepish and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a first-year hobby farmer in Ohio who mails a zip bag of his back-field dirt to the state university extension lab, brags to the feed store all month, and gets the report back saying it is mostly gravel and needs two tons of lime
tracks.caption: Country-trap, mid-2020s country and hip-hop crossover. Bright fingerpicked acoustic guitar loop and a rolling five-string banjo up front; a deep 808 sub bass and crisp rolling trap hi-hats underneath; offbeat handclaps and slippery dobro slides answering the vocal. Warm front-porch acoustic layer over a clean, modern half-time beat, dry close vocal. Male baritone with a relaxed half-sung, half-rapped drawl, a crowd of buddies shouting the chorus back. 82 BPM, G major. Swaggering, sheepish and laughing at himself. No autotune, no EDM drop, no stadium rock guitars, no pop-punk, no fiddle breakdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic and banjo, 808 drops in]

[Verse 1]
Bought five acres off a man named Del in Wayne County
Said it grew the best sweet corn that he'd ever seen
I dug a sample with a soup spoon at the fence line
Zipped it in a freezer bag and wrote my name in Sharpie green

[Pre-Chorus]
Twelve dollars and a stamp to Wooster
Told the boys at the feed store, wait and see

[Chorus]
Send it to the lab, send it to the lab
Let the college tell you what you got
Potassium, phosphorus, pH and all that
That dirt's gonna make me a whole lot

[Verse 2]
Three weeks later there's an envelope in the mailbox
Printed bars in yellow, every one of them is low
Says my pH is five point one and falling
Says it's mostly gravel, Del, and you already know

[Pre-Chorus]
Two tons of lime and a spreader rented Friday
And the feed store boys have pinned it to the board

[Chorus]
Sent it to the lab, sent it to the lab
And the college told me what I got
Gravel, a fence post and a bill for lime
And the feed store laughing at my lot

[Bridge - banjo and claps only]
Del waves from his porch every time I pass
I wave back with the lime dust on my hat

[Chorus]
Send it to the lab, send it to the lab
Next April I'll be back with my spoon
Potassium, phosphorus, pH and all that
That gravel's gonna grow me something soon

[Outro - banjo roll over 808, claps fade]

tracks.title: Through the Studio Glass
tracks.subject: a night security guard at a city art museum who falls for the paintings conservator working late on cleaning old varnish off a harbour painting, watching her through the conservation studio glass on every round and bringing her a vending-machine tea at three
tracks.caption: Alternative R&B soft rock with retro-pop cool and indie-rock guitar, mid-2020s style. Clean chorused electric guitar playing a looping arpeggio hook; a mellow Rhodes electric piano with gentle tremolo; a warm, round fingered bass guitar; live drums with brushed snare and rimshot backbeat; a light string pad under the chorus. Soft late-90s analog warmth, gentle tape saturation and small-room reverb. Female soprano in a light, airy head voice with a soft rasp, close-mic'd and intimate, stacked harmonies on the chorus. 104 BPM, A major. Tender, unhurried and quietly giddy. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM build, no gospel choir, no power-ballad belting.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chorused guitar arpeggio and Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
Eleven forty, I check the doors on the second floor
Torch on the Dutch room, torch on the harbour wall
There's one lamp burning past the sign that says staff only
And you with a cotton swab and the sea coming back slowly

[Pre-Chorus]
You lift the yellow off a boat that's been grey for a century
You don't look up, but you knock twice on the glass for me

[Chorus]
I walk the round just to pass your room
See you through the studio glass
Two minutes there is all I'm meant to do
I stay a little longer than that

[Verse 2]
Three o'clock, the tea machine eats my second pound
I bring you the one that worked and you put the swab down
You show me a sailor nobody's seen since eighteen-ninety
A red scarf at his neck, and you tell me it would suit me

[Pre-Chorus]
The radio crackles, someone asks where I am
I say the east wing, everything's quiet, I'm fine

[Chorus]
I walk the round just to pass your room
You let me in past the glass
Two minutes there is all I'm meant to do
And the second tea's gone down by half

[Bridge - guitar and brushes only]
When the boat is clean they'll hang it by the stairs
I'll stop there on my rounds and you'll be there

[Chorus]
I walk the round and I'm walking you home
Six a.m., the cleaners coming in
Two minutes there is all I'm meant to do
I'm meeting you at eleven again

[Outro - Rhodes and guitar, fading]

tracks.title: One Question at Window Nine
tracks.subject: a man queueing at seven in the morning outside the US embassy in London for his work visa interview, paying a shop round the corner five pounds to hold his phone, rehearsing answers for an hour, and getting asked one question at window nine
tracks.caption: Scandi garage rock revival, sharp-suited 2020s garage-punk style. Two overdriven rhythm guitars slashing tight downstroke chords, a fuzzy lead guitar playing a two-note stinging riff, a driving eighth-note bass, pounding live drums with crashing stops and starts, a shaken tambourine and a buzzing Farfisa-style organ. Raw, loud live-in-the-room recording, tight and dry with minimal overdubs. Male tenor lead with a yelping, cocky shouted delivery, the band barking gang vocals back. 152 BPM, E major. Frantic, cocky and comic. No pop-punk polish, no metal, no synths, no autotune, no ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - drum count, slashing guitars and organ]

[Verse 1]
Seven a.m. at Nine Elms in my wedding shoes
Form DS-one-sixty printed both sides, double-checked
No phones past the gate, so the corner shop holds it
Five pound a phone and a pink ticket up my sleeve

[Pre-Chorus]
I know my salary, I know my boss's middle name
I know the postcode of the office in Ohio

[Chorus]
Window nine, window nine
An hour of answers in my head
Window nine, window nine
One question and that's it

[Verse 2]
Metal detector takes my belt and my dignity
Number on a screen like I'm buying cheese
Glass and a microphone, a man with a moustache
He says so what's your job, I tell him, that's all he needs

[Pre-Chorus]
I had a speech about the weather and the Thames
He stamps it, says next, like I'm not even there

[Chorus]
Window nine, window nine
An hour of answers going spare
Window nine, window nine
One question, I'm out of there

[Bridge - stop, drums and shouts]
Pink ticket, five pound, get my phone back
Thirty-one messages, all of them from my mum

[Chorus]
Window nine, window nine
She asks how did it go
Window nine, window nine
Two hours, one question, Mum, I'm coming home

[Outro - crashing stops, organ hit, one last scream]

tracks.title: Six Hundred Grams
tracks.subject: a hedgehog rescue volunteer in a Sheffield terrace weighing autumn hoglets on kitchen scales at two in the morning, feeding them cat biscuits until each one passes six hundred grams and can be released before hibernation
tracks.caption: Sheffield bassline house, 2000s Niche-club sound in its 2025 revival. A wobbling, warbling detuned bassline synth bouncing in octaves, bright organ-stab chords, a hard four-to-the-floor kick with shuffled UK-garage hi-hats, snare rolls into every chorus and a cheap rave piano riff. Punchy club mix with loud, warbling mid-bass and a dry vocal on top. Female mezzo with a bright Northern pop-house delivery, a chanted call-and-response hook. 138 BPM, F minor. Bouncing, silly and warm-hearted. No trap, no dubstep drop, no autotune, no EDM supersaws, no drum and bass breakbeats.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - organ stabs and kick, bassline wobbles in]

[Verse 1]
Two a.m. in Walkley and the kettle's on
Seven boxes by the radiator, towels and a heat pad on
Prickles in a tea towel, set him on the scales
Four-oh-two and he's shouting at me, little snuffling wails

[Pre-Chorus]
Cat biscuits, water, mealworms off the menu
Write it on the whiteboard, Spike, Bramble, Kevin too

[Chorus]
Six hundred grams, six hundred grams
Get the weight on before the frost comes in
Six hundred grams, six hundred grams
Then I'll let you out by the bins

[Verse 2]
Bramble's at five-ninety, Bramble's on a roll
Kevin ate a whole bowl and then he slept inside the bowl
My fella's in his dressing gown, says it's half past three
He holds the torch, he holds the scales, he's holding Kev for me

[Pre-Chorus]
Ten more grams, come on, come on, Bramble
Kitchen floor's a dancefloor, everybody shuffle

[Chorus]
Six hundred grams, six hundred grams
Bramble's on the scales and the number's in
Six hundred grams, six hundred grams
So I'm letting you out by the bins

[Bridge - bassline and vocal only]
Gap in the fence by number forty-two
Go on then, love, I've left the door ajar for you

[Chorus]
Six hundred grams, six hundred grams
Kevin's still at four-eighty and a bit
Six hundred grams, six hundred grams

tracks.title: Grandad Nicked It from Kew
tracks.subject: a Peckham man carrying a six-foot cheese plant in a Lidl bag-for-life to Kew Gardens across London by bus, because his grandad pinched it as a finger-long cutting from the Palm House in 1971 and it has since eaten the whole front room, and the Kew botanist who looks at the leaves, says they lost that exact one in a 1987 storm, and takes it back for the glasshouse with his grandad's name on the label
tracks.caption: New-wave grime, London 140 sound in its mid-2020s renaissance. A cold square-wave lead synth playing an eskibeat-style riff, booming sub-bass hits, skippy syncopated 140 BPM drums with sharp claps, icy orchestral string stabs and a siren-like synth. Cold, sparse, hard-hitting pirate-radio grime mix. Male MC with a fast, punchy, cheeky London grime flow, ad-libs and a crowd-shouted hook. 140 BPM, C minor. Rowdy, cheeky and triumphant. No trap hi-hat rolls, no drill slides, no autotune, no sung R&B hook, no house kick.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - square-wave riff, sub-bass hit, MC ad-libs]

[Verse 1]
Nineteen seventy-one, Grandad's down at Kew in his flares
Snaps a leaf off in the Palm House, puts it in his pocket, no one cares
Jam jar on the windowsill, then a pot, then a bucket, then the floor
Now it's six foot tall in Peckham and we can't shut the front room door

[Pre-Chorus]
Grandad says take it back, son, I'm eighty-four
Tell 'em it was me, tell 'em sorry, tell 'em nothing more

[Chorus]
Grandad nicked it from Kew, Grandad nicked it from Kew
Fifty-odd years in the front room, now the plant wants home too
Grandad nicked it from Kew, Grandad nicked it from Kew
Three buses west with a leaf in my face, what you gonna do

[Verse 2]
Bag-for-life from Lidl and the leaves are poking out the top
Driver says that's not a passenger, I say it's family, mind the stop
Gate at Kew, a botanist, cardigan, the glasses on a string
She looks at it, she doesn't laugh, she says hold on, I know this thing

[Pre-Chorus]
Storm took ours in eighty-seven, never found another
This one's from the same old plant, it's the long-lost brother

[Chorus]
Grandad nicked it from Kew, Grandad nicked it from Kew
Now the Palm House wants it back and she's saying thank you
Grandad nicked it from Kew, Grandad nicked it from Kew
Fifty years on the windowsill and it's coming home brand new

[Bridge - strings and sub only]
Little white label, felt-tip pen
Donated by Ron, nineteen seventy-one to now

[Chorus]
Grandad gave it to Kew, Grandad gave it to Kew
Got his name in the glasshouse and a free pass too
Grandad gave it to Kew, Grandad gave it to Kew
Now he's asking what else in the flat he can take back through

[Outro - square-wave riff, ad-libs, cut to silence]

tracks.title: Lampu Buah Naga
tracks.subject: a Banyuwangi dragon-fruit farmer who lights his field with yellow lamps from six till five to force off-season flowers, watches his electricity bill double, and ends up charging the courting teenagers who sneak in at night five thousand rupiah to take photos among the glowing poles
tracks.caption: Kendang kempul Banyuwangi, the gandrung-rooted East Javanese regional pop that crosses Osing tradition with dangdut. A Banyuwangi kendang playing crisp, choppy slap patterns that sound nothing like a koplo kendang; a kempul gong landing on the backbeat; a kluncing triangle ringing steady eighths; a gandrung-style violin playing sliding slendro-flavoured fills between every vocal line; a reedy electric organ and a plain electric bass holding the groove. Dry, close regional-studio mix with the kendang upfront and only a short room reverb on the violin. Male mid-range lead with a bright, nasal village-singer tone, short gandrung-style ornaments at the ends of lines, chatty and teasing delivery. 124 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, bouncy and proud. No koplo breakdowns, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rock guitar, no Western pop chord ballad.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gandrung violin, kluncing triangle and a kendang roll]

[Verse 1]
Jam enam sore isun tekan sakelar
Seribu lampu kuning nyala satu kebun
Pohon naga nggak tahu ini bukan musimnya
Dikira masih siang, terus aja berbunga

[Pre-Chorus]
Tagihan listrik datang, istriku baca dua kali
Katanya kebun kita lebih terang dari kantor bupati

[Chorus]
Lampu buah naga, nyala sampai subuh
Bunganya mekar, yang pacaran ikut kumpul
Riko yang di pojok, isun lihat lho
Foto boleh, bayar lima ribu

[Verse 2]
Malam Minggu motor parkir di pematang
Anak SMA bawa tripod sama pacarnya
Ada yang berlutut di antara tiang beton
Cincinnya jatuh, dicari pakai senterku

[Chorus]
Lampu buah naga, nyala sampai subuh
Bunganya mekar, cincinnya ketemu
Riko berdua, isun jadi saksi
Foto boleh, bayar lima ribu

[Bridge - kendang and kempul alone, then violin]
Bunga naga cuma mekar satu malam saja
Persis kayak janji anak SMA

[Chorus]
Lampu buah naga, mati waktu subuh
Bunganya kuncup, pacarnya pada pulang
Tinggal isun sendiri ngitung lima ribuan
Lumayan buat nyicil tagihan

[Outro - violin flourish, kempul hit, kendang stop]

tracks.title: Gosok Bak Minum Dulu
tracks.subject: a Komodo keeper at Surabaya Zoo and the man who signs up as a Sunday volunteer because of her; she makes him scrub the water trough every Sunday for a month before she lets him hold the feeding pole
tracks.caption: Retro sweet soul in the current Surabaya revival style, late-60s Motown and Northern Soul filtered through Indonesian pop. A reverb-drenched, surf-tinged clean electric guitar playing tremolo arpeggios; a Hammond organ with slow Leslie swirl holding the chords; a two-piece horn section, trumpet and tenor sax, answering the vocal with short Motown stabs; a round fingered electric bass walking under live drums with a tambourine on the backbeat. Warm analog tape sound, mono-leaning drums, spring reverb on the guitar. Female alto lead, smooth and unhurried with a slight smoky grain, intimate in the verses and fuller in the chorus, sparse doo-wop backing oohs. 86 BPM, F major. Warm, teasing and quietly delighted. No modern R&B runs, no autotune, no trap drums, no city-pop synths, no EDM.

tracks.title: Laporan Jam Dua Pagi
tracks.subject: the night observer at the Merapi observation post in Kaliurang alone with the seismograph, counting avalanche quakes and phoning in the alert-level report to Yogyakarta, staged by himself as a one-man opera
tracks.caption: Indonesian musical-theatre show tune, a one-man opera patter number from a stage musical cast recording. A bright stride piano driving the vamp; clarinet runs and muted trumpet and trombone stabs punctuating every joke; pizzicato strings under the verses opening into bowed strings in the chorus; snare with brushes and a woodblock ticking the patter. Stage cast-recording sound with natural hall ambience, orchestra in front of the singers, no pop compression. Male tenor lead in fast, crisp comic patter with clear theatre diction, answered by a mixed ensemble playing the voices in his head and on the phone, a key change into the last chorus. 132 BPM, B-flat major. Breathless, grand and tongue-in-cheek. No pop drum kit, no EDM, no autotune, no rock guitar, no operatic vibrato.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pit orchestra fanfare, stride piano vamp]

[Verse 1 - Male lead, patter]
Pos Pengamatan Kaliurang, jam dua pagi
Kopi sachet ketiga, termos sudah sepi
Jarum seismograf menari di kertas gulung
Satu guguran, dua guguran, aku yang menghitung

[Pre-Chorus - Male lead]
Penontonku cuma cicak di atas jendela
Tapi malam ini aku bintang utama

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Merapi, Merapi, kamu nggak pernah tidur
Aku juga, aku juga, mata merah, jauh dari kasur
Garis naik, garis turun, catat semuanya
Status Siaga, belum berubah

[Verse 2 - Male lead, patter]
Lima belas kali guguran, arah barat daya
Asap putih tipis, tinggi lima puluh meter saja
Kutulis rapi di buku, angka sama jam
Lalu kuangkat telepon seperti aria malam

[Chorus - Ensemble]
Merapi, Merapi, kamu nggak pernah tidur
Aku juga, aku juga, sampai ayam jantan berkokok
Halo, Yogya, ini pos Kaliurang
Status Siaga, semua tenang

[Bridge - Ensemble as the voice on the phone, then Male lead]
"Terima kasih, Mas, laporannya diterima"
Klik, telepon mati, nggak ada tepuk tangan
Aku membungkuk ke arah gunung yang gelap
Cicak di jendela pun pergi diam-diam

[Chorus - Full ensemble, key change]
Merapi, Merapi, kamu nggak pernah tidur
Aku juga, aku juga, kursi penonton masih kosong
Jam enam ganti jaga, kopi buat temanku
Besok malam layar naik lagi

[Outro - orchestra button, one woodblock hit]

tracks.title: Kantor Pos Taichung
tracks.subject: an Indonesian caregiver in Taichung spending her one Sunday off at the post office, where the parcel home to Cilacap is half a kilo over and she takes out her own new sandals so her son's school shoes still fit in the box
tracks.caption: Modern TV dangdut ballad in the polished Jakarta studio style of current dangdut stars. A dangdut gendang pair playing a slow, deep dut-tak pattern; a bamboo suling with Melayu ornaments opening the song and answering the vocal; mandolin tremolo over a lush string section; a clean electric guitar playing the counter-melody; soft electric piano chords. Polished production with roomy reverb and the gendang clear and centred. Female mezzo lead with Melayu-dangdut cengkok and controlled vibrato, plain-spoken and close in the verses, full and ringing in the chorus. 76 BPM, D minor. Tender, homesick and stubborn. No koplo kendang, no EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no distorted rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - suling solo over mandolin tremolo, gendang enters]

[Verse 1]
Hari Minggu cuma satu dalam seminggu
Kupakai antre di kantor pos Taichung
Kardus mi instan kulakban tiga lapis
Alamat Cilacap kutulis besar-besar

[Pre-Chorus]
Petugas menimbang, angkanya merah
Lebih setengah kilo, harus dikurangi

[Chorus]
Kukeluarkan sandal baruku sendiri
Biar sepatu sekolahmu tetap muat
Ukuran tiga enam, kutebak dari foto
Nak, kalau kebesaran, sumpal kaus kaki

[Verse 2]
Kue nanas buat bapakmu di pangkalan
Jaket tebal buat ngojek subuh-subuh
Biar di jalan dia ingat ada yang nunggu
Lima bulan lagi kontrakku selesai

[Pre-Chorus]
Petugas tersenyum, tanya "Indonesia?"
Aku mengangguk, lupa bilang xie-xie

[Chorus]
Kukeluarkan sandal baruku sendiri
Kupakai lagi yang talinya sudah tipis
Sepatu sekolahmu pulang duluan, Nak
Ibu menyusul sesudah musim dingin

[Outro - suling and strings, gendang stops on the last line]
Ibu menyusul, Nak, sesudah musim dingin

tracks.title: Motif Jengkol
tracks.genre: Indonesian late-60s beat pop (Koes Plus style)
tracks.subject: a cap stamper at a batik workshop in Pekalongan who presses the hot copper stamp four hundred times a day, ordered by the owner's wife to stamp her new design, a jengkol-bean motif, onto three hundred metres of cloth, which the town hall then picks as the Friday uniform, so the whole town wears his stinky-bean batik and he walks around deadpan proud
tracks.caption: Indonesian late-60s beat pop in the Koes Plus and Dheng Dheng Plas tradition, Beat-era rock 'n' roll sung in Indonesian. A jangly clean electric rhythm guitar strumming eighth notes; a twangy lead guitar answering each line with short fills; a buzzy Farfisa-style combo organ holding the chords; a melodic picked electric bass; bright live drums with a tambourine on every beat. Dry live-room 1960s recording, guitars panned wide, slight tape saturation. Male baritone lead, relaxed conversational singing with dry deadpan wit, light group shouts in the chorus. 148 BPM, D major. Goofy, bright and deadpan proud. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no synths, no EDM, no dangdut or koplo kendang, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - jangly guitar riff and combo organ, drums kick in]

[Verse 1]
Jam tujuh pagi malam sudah mendidih
Cap tembaga kucelup, kutekan, kuangkat lagi
Empat ratus kali sehari, nggak pernah meleset
Sambungan motifku rapi kayak ubin masjid

[Pre-Chorus]
Lalu Bu Bos datang bawa gambar di kertas
"Ini motif baru," katanya, "motif jengkol"

[Chorus]
Jengkol, jengkol, tiga ratus meter
Kanan kiri, atas bawah, jengkol semua
Tanganku cap, cap, cap sampai sore
Kain wangi malam, motifnya bau dikit

[Verse 2]
Pak Lurah mampir, katanya cuma lihat-lihat
Pulangnya pesan seragam buat hari Jumat
Sekarang satu kantor pakai bajuku
Tukang parkir, guru, sampai Pak Camat

[Chorus]
Jengkol, jengkol, tiga ratus meter
Kanan kiri, atas bawah, jengkol semua
Setiap Jumat aku jalan pelan-pelan
Lihat kerjaku lewat naik motor

[Bridge - drums and tambourine only, handclaps]
Ada yang bilang ini motif paling aneh se-Pekalongan
Aku diam saja, aku cuma tukang cap

[Chorus]
Jengkol, jengkol, tiga ratus meter
Bu Bos sudah gambar motif pete
Aku celup cap lagi, nggak usah tanya
Jumat depan sekota pakai pete

[Outro - twangy guitar fill, organ chord, drums stop]

tracks.title: 二割まで
tracks.subject: a man whose dropped wallet comes back from the Tokyo police lost-property centre with every last coin, agonising by the phone over whether to give the high-school baseball player who found it five percent or the full twenty percent reward
tracks.caption: Japanese funk, the mid-2020s internet crossover of Brazilian baile funk and J-pop: a tamborzão drum pattern with dry snare and tom hits, a distorted 808 bass sliding between notes, a looping phonk cowbell melody, bright city-pop Rhodes electric piano stabs on the off-beats, and tight hand claps. Loud, saturated club mix with heavy sidechain on the bass and a dry, close vocal. Male tenor lead in fast, half-spoken Japanese patter that tightens into a chanted sing-along chorus, with a few gang shouts. 130 BPM, F# minor. Flustered, comic and danceable. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM build-up and drop, no Jersey club kicks, no rock guitars.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tamborzão drums, distorted 808 slides, phonk cowbell riff]

[Verse 1]
月曜の朝 財布がない
ポケット全部 三回裏返す
駅前交番で 用紙に書いた
黒い二つ折り 中身は三万

[Pre-Chorus]
木曜の夜 知らない番号
「遺失物センターです」って声

[Chorus]
五分から二割 お礼の相場
拾った人に いくら渡そう
三万円なら 千五百から六千
財布は戻った 悩みが増えた

[Verse 2]
飯田橋まで 取りに行ったら
小銭の七円まで 全部ある
拾い主は 高二の野球部
お礼の欄に 「請求する」

[Chorus]
五分から二割 お礼の相場
ケチと思われたくは ないけど
三万円なら 千五百から六千
電話の前で 正座してる

[Bridge - 808 drops out, cowbell and hand claps only]
グローブ買うには 足りないか
牛丼だったら 何杯いける

[Chorus]
五分から二割 決めたぞ二割
六千円を 封筒に入れて
「新しいボール 買ってくれ」って
一行だけ 書いて渡す

[Outro - tamborzão fades under the cowbell riff]

tracks.title: 雪の大谷攻城戦
tracks.subject: an April snow-clearing crew on the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route cutting the 20-metre 'snow corridor' at Murodo open with a rotary snow plough, the foreman directing it like a castle siege, the bus road due to open to tourists in a week
tracks.caption: Japanese gothic symphonic metal in the mid-2020s anime-band style: down-tuned seven-string guitars playing tight tremolo-picked and galloping riffs, double-kick drums, a cathedral pipe organ, a string section driving a spiccato ostinato, and harpsichord runs in the verses. Dense, dark, polished mix with wide choir reverb and a clean low end. Female mezzo-soprano lead with a theatrical, clear-toned delivery, half-sung verses rising to an operatic belt in the chorus, a mixed choir answering her. 148 BPM, D minor. Grandiose, mock-heroic and triumphant. No growled or screamed vocals, no metalcore breakdowns, no EDM synths, no pop-punk, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pipe organ chords, spiccato strings, double-kick drums enter]

[Verse 1]
四月の室堂 道はまだ白い
地図の上では ここにバスが通る
測量の竿を 雪に突き刺す
十八メートル 下にアスファルト

[Pre-Chorus]
親方が 無線で叫ぶ
「ロータリー 前へ」

[Chorus]
進め 進め 白い城壁へ
羽根車が 雪を空に吐く
一日三百メートル 攻め落とす
来週は 観光バスが来る

[Verse 2]
ブルドーザーが 先に掘り崩す
ロータリーが 後ろで壁を削る
雪の断面に 茶色い筋
三月の黄砂が 一本の線

[Chorus]
進め 進め 白い城壁へ
羽根車が 雪を空に吐く
一日三百メートル 攻め落とす
弁当の握り飯が 凍ってる

[Bridge - choir and organ, half-time]
雪の下から 道路標識
「この先 カーブ」 去年のままだ

[Chorus - full choir]
進め 進め 白い城壁へ
最後の一枚 突き破った
壁の上から 青空が見える
開通の朝 みんなで山を降りる

[Outro - organ alone, ringing out]

tracks.title: 橋をたたく
tracks.subject: an expressway bridge inspector who closes one lane at ten at night and works under the deck until dawn, tapping the concrete with a hammer and circling every spot that sounds hollow in chalk
tracks.caption: Japanese krautrock with a motorik beat, in the line of the Tokyo neo-krautrock bands: a metronomic four-on-the-floor drum pattern with a straight eighth-note hi-hat that never changes, a one-note pulsing picked bass, a droning Farfisa-style combo organ, a clean, repetitive chorused guitar figure, and a fuzz guitar that surges in the instrumental break. Dry, warm, tape-saturated live-room recording that builds by layering rather than by drops. Male baritone lead with a flat, deadpan, half-spoken delivery, steady and unhurried. 126 BPM, E minor. Hypnotic, nocturnal and focused. No pop chorus lift, no synth-pop, no EDM, no stadium rock solos, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - motorik drum beat alone, then the one-note bass pulse and organ drone]

[Verse 1]
夜十時 一車線だけ 止める
コーンを並べて 矢印を灯す
点検車の腕で 橋の腹へ
ハンマー一本 耳を澄ます

[Chorus]
コン コン コン 澄んだ音なら次
コン コン ボコ そこにチョークで丸
ひとつずつ たたいて 聞いていく
朝まで続く 四百メートル

[Verse 2]
真上をトラックが 五秒ごとに
橋がほんの少し 息をする
型枠の跡に 誰かの字
三十年前の 日付がある

[Chorus]
コン コン コン 澄んだ音なら次
コン コン ボコ そこに赤い丸
写真を撮って 番号をふる
朝まで続く 四百メートル

[Instrumental Break - fuzz guitar over the same motorik beat]

[Verse 3]
東の空が 白くなる前に
コーンを片付けて 一車線返す
誰も知らない 赤い丸が
今夜 十二個 増えただけ

[Chorus]
コン コン コン 澄んだ音なら次
コン コン ボコ 来月また来る
走る車の 下をたたいて
夜明けの前に 四百メートル

[Outro - motorik beat and organ drone, fading]

tracks.title: 日曜は二百メートル
tracks.subject: a man walking his twenty-two-year-old, thirty-kilo spurred tortoise along the riverbank every Sunday morning, two hundred metres an hour with dandelion stops, and carrying him home in his arms
tracks.caption: Japanese Hawaiian hapa-haole pop as played at Japan's hula festivals: a sliding lap steel guitar with long glissandos, a strummed concert ukulele, a slack-key acoustic guitar picking an open-tuned bass pattern, a plucked upright bass, and soft ipu gourd taps. Warm, sunny, unhurried acoustic mix with light plate reverb on the steel. Male mellow baritone lead, relaxed and smiling, with gentle falsetto breaks at the ends of chorus lines. 96 BPM, G major. Lazy, warm and quietly comic. No reggae, no drum kit, no electric guitar, no synthesizers, no bossa nova, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - lap steel glide, ukulele strum, slack-key guitar]

[Verse 1]
日曜の朝 河川敷へ
ケヅメのジロー 三十キロ
リードはあるけど 意味はない
行きたい方へ 行くだけだ

[Pre-Chorus]
タンポポ見つけて 止まったら
十五分は 動かない

[Chorus]
ゆっくりでいい 急ぐ用もない
二百メートルに 一時間
すれ違う犬が 三回振り返る
ジローは前しか 見ていない

[Verse 2]
子どもが集まる 「これ本物?」
「乗っていい?」って それはだめ
僕が十歳の 夏に来て
二十二年 同じ顔

[Chorus]
ゆっくりでいい 急ぐ用もない
二百メートルに 一時間
ベンチのじいさん 今日も手を振る
ジローは前しか 見ていない

[Bridge - lap steel solo, then softly]
帰りはいつも 僕が抱える
三十キロを 汗だくで

[Chorus]
ゆっくりでいい 急ぐ用もない
二百メートルに 一時間
来週もまた この土手で
ジローの後ろを 歩いてる

[Outro - lap steel and ukulele, slowing to a stop]

tracks.title: 허물 수집가
tracks.subject: a seven-year-old collecting cicada shells off the zelkova trees of her apartment-complex playground in August, hiding them in egg cartons at the bottom of the fridge to reach one hundred before school starts
tracks.caption: Chiptune 8-bit idol pop with a bright handheld-console bounce. Square-wave lead arpeggios running in sixteenths, a pulse-wave bass line hopping octaves, a triangle-wave countermelody, and crisp noise-channel drums with a punchy real kick underneath; short coin-collect blips between phrases. Dry, clean, close mix with tight sidechain and no reverb wash. Young female vocal, bright mid register, clipped playful delivery with spoken asides, a small group shout on the counting lines. 138 BPM, C major. Gleeful, mischievous and proud. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dubstep drop, no EDM supersaw build, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - square-wave arpeggio, 8-bit coin blips]

[Verse 1]
팔월 아침 일곱 시 놀이터 느티나무
껍데기만 남은 매미가 줄기에 꼭 붙어 있어
등이 쩍 갈라졌는데 발톱까지 그대로야
살살 떼면 하나, 앗 다리 하나 부러졌다

[Pre-Chorus]
계란판 열두 칸에 오늘 벌써 아홉 개
엄마는 몰라, 냉장고 맨 아래 칸

[Chorus]
하나 둘 셋 매미 허물
서른일곱 개째 레벨 업
개학 전에 백 개 채울 거야
울음소리는 나무에 두고 껍데기만 내 거

[Verse 2]
옆 동 민준이는 사슴벌레 있다고 자랑해
나는 허물로 탑을 쌓아 벌써 열 층이야
경비 아저씨가 빗자루로 높은 가지 톡
떨어지는 걸 모자로 받으면 보너스 두 배

[Chorus]
하나 둘 셋 매미 허물
예순 개째 계란판 다섯 판
그런데 엄마가 계란 꺼내다
냉장고 앞에서 비명 질렀어

[Bridge - chiptune breakdown, bass blips only]
베란다로 쫓겨난 내 계란판 다섯 판
밤에 몰래 세어 보니 하나도 안 없어졌어

[Chorus]
하나 둘 셋 매미 허물
아흔아홉, 딱 하나 남았어
개학 날 아침 백 개째는
교문 앞 은행나무에 붙어 있었어

[Outro - square-wave victory jingle]

tracks.title: 삼삼 활주로
tracks.subject: the Incheon Airport wildlife-control team at dawn, driving the runway in hi-vis vests, firing blank cartridges and playing recorded hawk calls to clear a flock of egrets off runway 33 before the 6:10 first landing
tracks.caption: 80s retro synth-pop in the 2025 K-pop revival style. Bright Juno-style polysynth arpeggio, a warm analog synth bass in driving eighth notes, chorus-drenched clean electric guitar playing short muted stabs, gated-reverb snare with LinnDrum-style claps, and a glassy DX7-style electric piano on the pre-chorus. Wide glossy mix with tape warmth and big gated drums. Female vocal, clear mid-high register, airy and tender in the verses, lifting to a bright confident chorus. 118 BPM, A major. Brisk, cheeky and bright. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no future-bass synths, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gated drums, bright polysynth arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
새벽 네 시 반 인천공항 북쪽 끝
형광 조끼 입고 트럭 시동 걸어
삼삼 활주로 위 하얀 백로 열두 마리
첫 비행기 오기 전에 다 보내야 해

[Pre-Chorus]
스피커엔 매 울음소리 크게 틀고
공포탄 한 발, 탕!

[Chorus]
훠이 훠이 백로야 저리 가
여긴 너희 논이 아니야
여섯 시 십 분 첫 비행기
바퀴가 내려올 자리야

[Verse 2]
꼭 한 마리가 안 가고 버텨
목을 길게 빼고 우릴 쳐다봐
반장님이 확성기로 너 어제 걔지?
트럭 한 바퀴 더 돌고서야 날아가

[Chorus]
훠이 훠이 백로야 저리 가
저 건너 갯벌이 더 넓어
여섯 시 십 분 첫 비행기
관제탑이 무전으로 불러

[Bridge - electric piano and synth bass only]
활주로 클리어, 그 한마디에
트럭 안 우리 넷이 하이파이브

[Chorus]
훠이 훠이 백로야 잘 가
내일 새벽에 또 보자
바퀴 닿는 소리 들으면서
보온병 커피 뚜껑을 열어

[Outro - polysynth arpeggio, gated snare fading]

tracks.title: 거꾸로 새긴 이름
tracks.subject: a dojang seal-engraver in a second-floor Insadong workshop carving forty name seals in one day for a company's new hires, who start the next morning, reading every name backwards as he cuts it in mirror image
tracks.caption: Math rock guitar pop in the bright idol-band style. Two clean electric guitars tapping interlocking odd-meter riffs in 7/8 that resolve into straight 4/4 choruses, a nimble fingered electric bass playing melodic runs, a tight live drum kit with crisp rimshots and quick hi-hat accents, and a glockenspiel doubling the hook. Dry, bright, close-miked band mix with no heavy distortion. Male vocal, quick articulate mid register, clipped and precise in the verses, open and bright on the chorus. 144 BPM, E major. Busy, cheerful and nimble. No trap drums, no autotune, no synth pads, no EDM drop, no heavy metal riffs.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tapped clean guitar riff in 7/8, tight hi-hat]

[Verse 1]
인사동 골목 이층 도장 가게
아침 아홉 시에 들어온 팩스 한 장
신입사원 마흔 명 이름 목록
내일 아침이 입사식이래

[Pre-Chorus]
돌 마흔 개 줄 세우고 먹을 갈고
돋보기 내리고 칼끝을 세워

[Chorus]
거꾸로 읽고 거꾸로 새겨
김민준은 준민김
찍어 보면 똑바로 서는 이름
마흔 개 중에 하나 끝

[Verse 2]
점심은 칼 내려놓고 김밥 한 줄
오후 세 시 박서연이 또 나왔어
오늘만 벌써 세 번째 박서연
셋 다 같은 날 첫 출근이래

[Chorus]
거꾸로 읽고 거꾸로 새겨
박서연은 연서박
인주 묻혀 꾹 찍어 보면
반듯하게 웃는 이름

[Bridge - odd-meter breakdown, guitars in counterpoint]
저녁 여덟 시 마지막 돌 하나
덤으로 붙은 사장님 이름, 숨 참고

[Chorus]
거꾸로 읽고 거꾸로 새겨
마흔 개 다 줄 세웠어
내일 아침 첫 서류 위에
마흔 개의 첫 도장

[Outro - tapped riff resolves, one cymbal choke]

tracks.title: 일곱 분마다
tracks.subject: a man staying up through the thirty-hour wood firing of his potter girlfriend's climbing kiln in Icheon, feeding it two logs every seven minutes beside her, with a ring box in his bag he plans to give her the day the kiln is opened
tracks.caption: Korean rock ballad in the power-ballad tradition that topped the 2025 charts. Clean arpeggiated electric guitar in the verses, felt grand piano chords, a full live drum kit entering on the first chorus with big tom fills, overdriven rhythm guitar under the chorus, and a singing sustained electric guitar solo before the last chorus, with a soft string section underneath. Warm wide mix, long plate reverb on the guitar solo. Male tenor vocal, gentle and close in the verses, building to a full open belt with clean high notes on the chorus. 72 BPM, B-flat major. Devoted, warm and steady. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap, no orchestral bombast.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean arpeggiated electric guitar and piano]

[Verse 1]
이천 산자락 오름가마 앞에
장작 한 아름 안고 너랑 앉았어
불 넣은 지 열 시간, 아직 스무 시간
눈썹까지 그을린 네가 웃어

[Pre-Chorus]
일곱 분마다 한 번씩
장작 두 개 넣고 다시 기다려

[Chorus]
불 앞에서 너를 지킬게
졸린 눈 비벼 가며
네가 빚은 그릇들이
다 익을 때까지

[Verse 2]
새벽 세 시 불빛이 주황에서 하얗게 바뀌고
넌 작은 구멍으로 불 색을 읽어
나는 시계만 보다가 또 장작을 들고
가방 속 작은 상자를 몇 번 만져 봐

[Chorus]
불 앞에서 너를 지킬게
손바닥이 다 갈라져도
네가 빚은 찻사발 하나
식을 때까지

[Bridge - guitar solo, then half-time]
사흘 뒤에 가마 문 여는 날
제일 먼저 꺼낸 잔에 반지를 넣을게

[Chorus]
그날 너를 불러 세울게
재 묻은 그 손 잡고
네가 빚은 첫 잔을 들고
같이 살자 말할게

[Outro - sustained guitar feedback, last piano chord]

tracks.title: 녹아라 계량기
tracks.subject: a young man in a one-room flat at 6:40 on the third morning of a cold-wave warning, with a job interview at 9:30, thawing the frozen water meter by the front door with microwaved bottled water and a hairdryer while the landlord lectures him by phone
tracks.caption: Korean post-hardcore with sludge-metal weight, in the current Seoul underground style. Downtuned baritone electric guitars playing slow sludgy riffs that snap into fast palm-muted post-hardcore picking, a distorted grinding bass guitar, pounding live drums with double-kick bursts and crash-heavy half-time breakdowns, and a clean chiming guitar arpeggio in the bridge. Raw, loud, room-heavy band mix with amp feedback between sections. Male vocal, clean urgent mid-range singing in the verses and hoarse shouted gang-vocal choruses, every word clear. 152 BPM, D minor. Frantic, absurd and stubborn. No autotune, no trap drums, no synths, no rap, no growled death-metal vocals, no glossy pop chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sludgy downtuned riff, amp feedback, floor-tom hits]

[Verse 1]
한파주의보 사흘째 아침 여섯 시 사십 분
면접은 아홉 시 반, 샤워기를 틀었는데
쉭 하고 바람 소리만, 물 한 방울 안 나와
현관 옆 계량기 뚜껑 여니 하얗게 얼었어

[Pre-Chorus]
편의점 생수 두 병 전자레인지에 돌려
미지근하게 천천히, 조금씩 부어

[Chorus - shouted gang vocals]
녹아라 녹아라 계량기
영하 십팔 도 너 혼자 버티지 마
드라이어 최대로 수건 칭칭 감고
아홉 시 반까지 녹아라

[Verse 2]
집주인 아저씨 전화로 뜨거운 물은 붓지 말래
헌 옷으로 감싸 놨어야지, 이제 와서 그 소리
드라이어 쥔 손이 시려서 장갑 끼고
양복바지 위에 패딩 입고 쪼그려 앉았어

[Chorus - shouted gang vocals]
녹아라 녹아라 계량기
영하 십팔 도 나도 버티는 중이야
바늘아 돌아라 한 칸만 돌아라
여덟 시 반까지 녹아라

[Bridge - half-time sludge breakdown, then clean chiming guitar]
똑, 똑, 그리고 파이프가 쿨럭쿨럭
욕실에서 들려오는 첫 물소리

[Chorus - shouted gang vocals]
녹았다 녹았다 계량기
머리는 감았는데 말릴 시간이 없어
젖은 머리 끝에 고드름 달고

tracks.title: Ayam Abang, Cili Saya
tracks.genre: Malay folk-tune modern pop (pop moden bernuansa tradisional)
tracks.subject: a wife whose twelve new chilli plants by the back fence are dug up every day by her husband's three free-range kampung hens, until he offers her one warm egg a day as rent for the garden
tracks.caption: Malay folk-tune modern pop (pop moden bernuansa tradisional) built on a playground game-song melody, in the mid-2020s AJL style. A kompang frame-drum ensemble playing interlocking procession patterns; a gendang ibu and gendang anak pair driving a bouncing two-bar cycle; a bamboo seruling flute answering every vocal line; a clean, bright electric guitar chopping the offbeats; round synth bass under a tight modern pop drum kit. Clean, bright radio mix with dry, close percussion and a short room reverb. Female lead with a bright mid-register chest voice and a playful, teasing half-spoken delivery, a small group of women shouting the chant back. 116 BPM, D major. Cheeky, sunny and domestic. No dangdut, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no joget accordion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - kompang pattern and bamboo seruling, then the full band]

[Verse 1]
Pagi Sabtu aku tanam cili padi
Dua belas pokok tepi pagar belakang
Abang sumpah ayam dia tak pandai mencuri
Petang tu yang tinggal cuma lubang-lubang

[Pre-Chorus]
Si Merah korek, si Tompok jaga
Si Gemuk duduk atas guni baja

[Chorus]
Kok kok kek, ayam abang
Pagar aku dia buat tangga
Kok kok kek, jangan pandang-pandang
Malam ni nak makan kari, bang?

[Verse 2]
Hari Ahad aku pasang jaring biru
Isnin pagi jaring tu jadi buaian
Abang gelak, kata ayam pun nak tahu
Rasa cili yang aku jaga macam intan

[Chorus]
Kok kok kek, ayam abang
Pagar aku dia buat tangga
Kok kok kek, jangan pandang-pandang
Sabtu ni kita buat kenduri, bang?

[Bridge - kompang and gendang only]
Abang hulur sebiji telur, masih suam dalam tangan
"Ni sewa tanah," katanya, "cili kau aku jaga"

[Chorus]
Kok kok kek, ayam abang
Sebiji telur, satu pokok cili
Kok kok kek, kita berdamai
Tapi si Gemuk, jangan datang lagi!

[Outro - kompang and seruling trade the hook, band stops on one hit]

tracks.title: Van Buku Khamis Kedua
tracks.subject: a man courting the librarian on the state mobile-library van that parks under the balai raya's angsana tree in his kampung every second Thursday evening, borrowing thick books he never opens (tractor manuals, a Russian novel, a cookbook in French) just to have a reason to come back and return them, until she stamps a return date that falls on a Saturday and writes her own name beside it
tracks.caption: Malaysian city pop in the 1980s Japanese city-pop tradition, as revived by 2020s Malaysian bands. Slap-and-pop electric bass running busy sixteenths; Fender Rhodes playing major-seventh and ninth chords; a clean, chorus-drenched Stratocaster cutting a sixteenth-note funk rhythm; a tight brass section of trumpet, alto sax and trombone with short stabs and a sax line in the turnaround; a DX7 electric-piano bell doubling the hook. Polished late-night analog mix, gated plate reverb on the snare, wide stereo, soft tape saturation. Male light tenor, smooth and warm, unhurried phrasing with a falsetto lift in the chorus, female backing harmonies on the hook. 104 BPM, F major. Warm, flirtatious and teasing. No trap drums, no EDM, no autotune, no ballad piano, no synthwave arpeggios.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - slap bass and Rhodes chords, a bright brass stab]

[Verse 1]
Khamis kedua, pukul lima petang
Van biru berhenti bawah pokok angsana
Pintu sisi terbuka, kipas kecil berpusing
Kau duduk dengan cop tarikh, tudung warna kunyit

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku pinjam manual traktor, aku tak ada traktor
Aku pinjam novel Rusia, empat ratus muka surat

[Chorus]
Dua minggu sekali aku datang pulangkan
Buku yang tak pernah aku buka
Kau cop lagi, kau senyum lagi
"Encik dah habis baca ke?"

[Verse 2]
Minggu ni buku masakan, semua dalam bahasa Perancis
Kau angkat kening, "Encik masak apa malam ni?"
Aku jawab maggi, budak-budak beratur gelak
Pak cik pemandu hon dua kali, dah nak gerak

[Chorus]
Dua minggu sekali aku datang pulangkan
Buku yang tak pernah aku buka
Kau cop lagi, kau senyum lagi
"Encik dah habis baca ke?"

[Bridge - Rhodes and bass, brass drops out]
Hari ni kau cop tarikh hari Sabtu
Van tak datang hari Sabtu
Bawah cop tu kau tulis nama kau
Dengan nombor dan "kedai kopi depan masjid"

[Chorus]
Sabtu pagi aku datang awal
Bawa novel Rusia tu sekali
Kali ni aku baca muka surat satu
Sementara tunggu kau sampai

[Outro - sax line over the hook, Rhodes fades]

tracks.title: Ular Dalam Bonet
tracks.subject: a Bomba snake-catching unit pulling a 4-metre python out of the engine bay of a Proton Saga in a Shah Alam shopping-mall car park while the owner livestreams the whole thing, begging viewers for likes and asking the firemen to wave
tracks.caption: Malaysian hardcore punk, fast old-school and youth-crew style with a mosh breakdown. Two distorted guitars playing open-chord blasts and palm-muted chugs; a gritty overdriven bass locked to the kick; live drums switching between d-beat and double-time thrash beats with crash-heavy fills; feedback ringing between sections. Raw, loud live-room basement mix, little reverb, slight tape grit. Female lead with a hoarse, shouted chest voice in hardcore cadence, a gang of mixed voices shouting the chorus back. 176 BPM, E minor. Furious, comic and indignant. No pop-punk melodies, no metalcore clean choruses, no death-metal growls, no autotune, no synths.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - guitar feedback, a drum count-in, gang shout]

[Verse 1]
Tingkat B2, panas macam ketuhar
Saga merah tak nak hidup, bunyi pelik bawah bonet
Buka sikit, ada sisik, ada mata
Empat meter ular sawa peluk enjin dia!

[Pre-Chorus]
Tuan kereta tak lari, tuan kereta pegang telefon
"Geng, tekan like! Bomba dah sampai!"

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Ular dalam bonet! Tarik! Tarik!
Bomba masuk, tangan dalam enjin!
Ular dalam bonet! Jangan live!
Abang, tolong ke tepi sikit!

[Verse 2]
Kayu cangkuk, guni, sarung tangan tebal
Ekor lilit kipas radiator dua kali
Pengawal parkir panjat atas tong sampah
Tuan kereta jerit, "Bang, lambai kat kamera!"

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Ular dalam bonet! Tarik! Tarik!
Bomba masuk, tangan dalam enjin!
Ular dalam bonet! Jangan live!
Seribu orang tengok kau menjerit!

[Bridge - half-time breakdown]
Satu, dua, tiga, angkat!
Kepala keluar, guni dah ikat

[Chorus - gang vocals, double time]
Ular dalam guni! Siap! Siap!
Bomba lap peluh, guard turun dari tong!
Kereta hidup, live pun habis
Komen pertama: "Ular tu lagi hensem!"

[Outro - double-time blast, dead stop]

tracks.title: Gendang Di Pagar Sekolah
tracks.subject: the security guard of a kampung primary school who brings his gendang to the gate on the first day of term, with the bus driver on serunai and the office clerk on gong, until the crying Year One children march in and the mothers are the ones crying
tracks.caption: Malay gendang silat song, the drum-and-shawm ensemble that accompanies silat displays, set as a rousing folk song. A serunai shawm playing a nasal, ornamented modal melody with circular breathing; a gendang ibu and gendang anak pair in fast interlocking strokes, booming open tones against sharp slaps; a hanging tetawak gong marking every cycle; small kesi hand cymbals ticking the time. Outdoor close-mic folk recording with a little school-yard echo, no modern drum kit. Male lead with a warm mid-baritone and a rough, cheerful village-elder delivery, a small group of men answering the chorus. 128 BPM, G minor. Rousing, warm and comic. No pop drums, no EDM, no dangdut, no rock guitars, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - serunai solo over gendang ibu and gendang anak, gong on every cycle]

[Verse 1]
Pukul tujuh pagi, pintu pagar aku buka
Budak Tahun Satu, beg lebih besar dari badan
Ada yang pegang kain mak, tak nak lepas
Ada yang menangis sampai basah lengan baju

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku letak topi guard atas kerusi
Ambil gendang ibu yang aku bawa dari rumah

[Chorus]
Tak, tak, dum! Gendang di pagar
Serunai Pak Leh mula meninggi
Lap air mata, angkat kaki
Masuk kelas macam pendekar!

[Verse 2]
Pak Leh drebar bas, serunai dalam beg
Kak Yah kerani gantung gong tepi pejabat
Si Danish berhenti nangis, mula hentak kaki
Si Aisyah tolak tangan mak, "Mak balik la, cepat!"

[Chorus]
Tak, tak, dum! Gendang di pagar
Serunai Pak Leh makin meninggi
Sekarang mak-mak pula yang menangis
Anak dah berbaris macam pendekar!

[Bridge - gendang solo, gong on the cycle]
Loceng berbunyi, gendang aku perlahankan
Topi aku pakai balik, pagar aku jaga macam biasa

[Chorus]
Tak, tak, dum! Gendang di pagar
Tahun depan giliran siapa?
Kalau ada yang menangis lagi
Pak Mat ada, gendang pun ada!

[Outro - serunai and gendang speed up, one last gong]

tracks.title: Kanan Ke Kiri
tracks.subject: a signboard painter with thirty years of steady hands who cannot read Jawi, joining a Tuesday-night adult Jawi class in the community hall so he can repaint the cloth shop's sign without getting a single letter backwards
tracks.caption: Malay post-punk with a cold-wave edge, in the line of late-70s and 80s British post-punk kept alive by long-running Malaysian bands. A melodic, chorus-effected bass played high on the neck carrying the riff; an angular, trebly flanged guitar in clipped single-note stabs and ringing open chords; tight, dry motorik drums with a busy hi-hat; a cold monophonic synth drone with an occasional clipped synth-string line. Dry, close, slightly lo-fi 80s mix with spring reverb on the guitar. Male baritone, deadpan, low and steady, chanting the hook with flat restraint and lifting into a strained shout on the last chorus. 148 BPM, B minor. Tense, wry and stubborn. No pop-punk, no shoegaze wall of sound, no synthwave, no autotune, no trap drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - chorused bass riff, motorik drums, cold synth drone]

[Verse 1]
Tiga puluh tahun aku cat papan tanda
Huruf rumi, merah, kuning, pejam mata pun boleh
Haji Osman nak nama kedai kain dia dalam Jawi
Aku tengok huruf tu macam tengok wayar berselirat

[Pre-Chorus]
Selasa malam, dewan orang ramai
Lima belas orang tua, buku latihan budak darjah satu

[Chorus]
Kanan ke kiri, kanan ke kiri
Tangan aku melawan arah sendiri
Alif, ba, ta, titik bawah, titik atas
Kanan ke kiri, jangan terbalik lagi

[Verse 2]
Ustazah ketuk meja, "Ini nga, bukan ain"
"Kira titik dia, pak cik, tiga, bukan satu"
Kertas latihan aku tampal kat dinding bengkel
Pukul dua pagi aku masih lukis huruf sin

[Chorus]
Kanan ke kiri, kanan ke kiri
Berus aku belajar jalan sendiri
Kaf, lam, nga, tiga titik di atas
Kanan ke kiri, jangan terbalik lagi

[Bridge - bass and drums only, guitar feedback rising]
Sabtu pagi atas tangga besi depan kedai
Haji Osman baca dari bawah, satu-satu, tak ada yang salah

[Chorus - shouted]
Kanan ke kiri, kanan ke kiri
Cat kuning belum kering lagi
Orang lalu berhenti, dongak, membaca
Kanan ke kiri, tak terbalik lagi

[Outro - bass riff alone, then a hard stop]

tracks.title: 我毋是鮭魚 Guá M̄-sī Kue-hî
tracks.mood: deadpan, sheepish and bouncy, a joke the singer has finally stopped living inside
tracks.subject: a man who changed his legal name to 'Lim Salmon' in 2021 for a free sushi-restaurant feast and has lived with it on every bank queue screen and job interview since, back at the household registration office for his third and, by law, last name change, while the clerk reminds him this one is final
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien amapiano in the South African private-school piano style. A deep amapiano log drum bass sliding and gliding between notes; a soft shaker and open hi-hat on a laid-back swung groove; warm Rhodes electric piano chords with jazzy extensions; an airy synth pad; dry hand claps on the offbeats. Spacious, warm late-night mix with the log drum sitting under everything. A relaxed male baritone singing conversationally and straight-faced, with a light group-vocal answer on the chorus. 113 BPM, F minor. Deadpan, sheepish and bouncy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM build or drop, no rap verse, no Afrobeats guitar, no pop ballad chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
彼年春天 壽司店貼一張紙
名內底有鮭魚 規桌免錢食
我騎去戶政事務所 抽著三號
身分證面頂 我變做林鮭魚

食甲第九盤 頭家目睭紅紅

tracks.title: 四點落梨山 Sì Tiám Lo̍h Lî-san
tracks.mood: giddy, wide awake and racing the clock, a mountain descent against the auction bell
tracks.subject: a young woman who takes over her father's cabbage truck the night his back gives out, loads four hundred crates of high-mountain cabbage in Lishan at three in the morning and races down the switchbacks through Yilan at first light to make the seven o'clock auction at the Taipei fruit and vegetable wholesale market, her mother phoning every hour and one cabbage bouncing off the back on a bend
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Eurobeat in the late-90s Italian-Japanese Super Eurobeat style. A driving four-on-the-floor kick with offbeat open hi-hats; an octave-jumping synth bass; a stabbing brass-synth riff; a fast arpeggiated lead synth; orchestra-hit accents on the turnarounds. Bright, compressed Avex-era mix with loud synths and glossy vocal reverb. A bright young female lead singing light and quick, with a gang shout on the chorus. 155 BPM, D minor. Giddy, wide awake and racing the clock. No house piano, no UK garage shuffle, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dubstep drop, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
梨山的高麗菜 三點就割好
四百籠 疊甲比我閣較懸
阿爸腰閃著 鎖匙擲予我
伊講 七點前 愛到台北

[Pre-Chorus]
引擎發動 天猶烏烏
頭燈照著 彎彎的山路

[Chorus]
緊落山 緊落山
高麗菜 咧等拍賣
緊落山 緊落山
七點前 我一定到

[Verse]
一个彎 閣一个彎
菜籠 佇後斗咧跳舞

我無閒停 伊家己去𨑨迌

阿母敲電話 一點鐘一擺
問我 有食飽未

[Chorus]
緊落山 緊落山
高麗菜 咧等拍賣
緊落山 緊落山

tracks.title: 菜寮溪 Tshài-liâu-khe
tracks.mood: sunny, stubborn and warm-hearted, an old man's small triumph
tracks.subject: a retired farmer in Zuojhen, Tainan, who walks the dry white riverbed of the Tsailiao Creek every winter with a small hammer looking for fossils, is called mad by the village until the young woman at the local fossil museum identifies his find as a rhinoceros tooth and writes his name under it, and now leads a line of children with toy hammers
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien cumbia in the classic Mexican-Colombian dance-hall style. A button accordion playing bright, bouncing riffs; a güiro scraper ticking on every beat; congas and timbales with fills into each chorus; a round electric bass on the two-note cumbia pattern; clean electric guitar chops on the offbeat. Bright, dry, live-band mix with the accordion up front. A warm, slightly raspy male baritone telling the story with a grin, children's voices joining on the last chorus. 98 BPM, D major. Sunny, stubborn and warm-hearted. No reggaeton dembow, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no pop ballad chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
透早 阿土伯 戴一頂竹笠仔
手攑一支 細支的鐵鎚仔
菜寮溪 寒天水焦焦
白色的溪埔 伊一步一步看

[Pre-Chorus]
人講伊老矣 頭殼歹去
伊講石頭內底 有物件咧等

[Chorus]
敲一下 叩叩叩
土底的骨頭 咧應伊
幾十萬年 才等著今仔日
阿土伯 來揣你轉去

[Verse]
有一工 鐵鎚敲著 一粒硬硬的
一支牙 比伊的拳頭閣較大
伊用面巾 包甲密密
騎鐵馬 載去庄內的化石館

[Pre-Chorus]
館內的小姐 目鏡戴起來
看一下講 這是犀牛的牙

[Chorus]
敲一下 叩叩叩
犀牛 佇遮行過路
幾十萬年 才等著今仔日
簿仔頂 寫阿土伯的名

[Verse]
這馬伊的後壁 綴一陣囡仔
逐个攑一支 塑膠的鐵鎚仔
伊教 敲毋通傷大力
看著白色的 就喝伊來看

[Bridge]
伊坐佇館內 看玻璃櫥仔
犀牛牙下底 一張細細的紙
寫的是 伊的名

[Chorus]
敲一下 叩叩叩
囡仔喝甲 規溪埔攏聽著
幾十萬年 才等著今仔日
明年寒天 閣來揣你

[Outro]
叩 叩 叩

tracks.title: 通譯 Thong-i̍k
tracks.mood: tense, dry and wry, with a soft landing
tracks.subject: a young Taigi interpreter at a district court civil hearing, translating for an old farmer who speaks only Taigi against a construction company whose new wall sits thirty centimetres inside his field, swallowing the curse he shouts at the company's lawyer, and hearing the judge order a fresh survey
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien spaghetti-western noir in the 1960s Italian western film-score style. A twangy baritone electric guitar with heavy spring reverb and tremolo; a lone trumpet answering the vocal; strummed nylon-string guitar; a galloping snare and floor-tom pattern; timpani hits on the turnarounds; a dry electric bass ostinato. Dry, wide film-score mix with cavernous spring reverb and lots of empty space. A cool, low female alto, half-spoken and clipped in the verses, opening up on the chorus. 124 BPM, A minor. Tense, dry and wry, with a soft landing. No post-punk, no motorik beat, no surf-rock drums, no synths, no pop, no autotune, no rap verse, no trap drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
第三法庭 冷氣開甲傷冷
法官講華語 一句一句慢慢仔講
阿財伯 穿一領洗甲白去的衫
伊越頭看我 我是通譯

[Pre-Chorus]
伊講的 我講
我講的 伊聽

[Chorus]
伊講 彼堵壁 食入阮的田
三十公分 三十公分
伊講 阮阿公就種到遐
我共翻做 法官聽有的話

[Verse]
公司的律師 西裝烏甲金
圖攤佇桌頂 線畫甲足直
阿財伯拍桌 喝一句足歹聽的
彼句 我吞落去

[Pre-Chorus]
法官看我
我看我的筆記

[Chorus]
伊講 彼堵壁 食入阮的田
三十公分 三十公分
伊講 伊的跤步 就是尺
我翻 伊對彼塊地 上熟

[Verse]
法官講 擇日 閣再量一擺
阿財伯 毋知這是贏抑是輸
我共伊講 地政的人 會去田頭量
伊點頭 手猶咧顫

[Bridge]
伊講 少年的
我罵的彼句
你哪攏無翻

[Chorus]
伊講 彼堵壁 食入阮的田
三十公分 三十公分
測量彼工 伊欲徛佇界石邊
我嘛會去 這擺免翻

[Outro]

tracks.title: 蜂仔佮龍眼花 Phang-á kah Lîng-gíng-hue
tracks.mood: tender, shy and warm, a sunny week of blossom season side by side
tracks.subject: a young migratory beekeeper who trucks forty hives into a Dongshan longan orchard for the April blossom and courts the owner's daughter while she walks the rows with him in the midday heat; she laughs at his veil, binds a sting on his wrist with her handkerchief, dips her finger into the first frame of longan honey before her father can, and asks him to bring the bees back next April
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Bollywood filmi romance in the modern Hindi film-soundtrack style. A sitar melody over a tanpura drone; tabla on a gentle keherwa groove; harmonium swells; a lush Bollywood string section answering each vocal phrase; bansuri flute fills. Lush, polished film-soundtrack mix with wide strings and a close, warm vocal. A warm, smooth male tenor with light filmi ornaments and gentle melisma, intimate and earnest. 86 BPM, A major. Tender, shy and warm, sunlit. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no Western pop-ballad piano, no bhangra dhol.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
四月 東山的龍眼花開
我載四十箱蜂 來你兜的園
你阿爸講 園仔大 會揣無路
叫你 𤆬我行一輪

[Pre-Chorus]
你戴笠仔 我戴網仔
你笑我 若像欲去娶某

[Chorus]
龍眼花 一欉一欉白
蜂仔 嗡嗡咧唱歌
日頭 曝甲頭殼燒燒
我毋敢看你 干焦看花

[Verse]
中晝 我掀開第三箱
一隻蜂 叮佇我的手腕
你走過來 提出你的手巾仔
共我縛甲 若像一粒肉粽

[Pre-Chorus]
你講 疼就喝出來
我講 無疼 喙煞咧顫

[Chorus]
龍眼花 一欉一欉白
蜂仔 嗡嗡咧唱歌
你縛的彼條手巾仔
我歸禮拜 毋甘解

[Verse]
花謝矣 蜜嘛飽矣
我捧頭一框蜜 出來
你阿爸猶未開喙
你的指頭仔 先點落去

[Bridge]
你舐一下 目睭瞇瞇
你講 這是阮兜的花
愛閣甜 就愛閣來

[Chorus]
明年 龍眼花閣開的時
你講 蜂仔愛閣載來
我講 蜂仔會來
我嘛會來

[Outro]
手巾仔 猶縛佇我的手

tracks.title: ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว (Here Comes the New Sign)
tracks.subject: the megaphone woman on a Bang Phlat district-office crew swapping the faded blue street-name signs down one soi in a single afternoon, announcing every stop through a megaphone while the aunties argue the new sign is spelled wrong, a noodle shop owner protests the two thousand business cards he printed with the old soi number, and kids pose for photos under each sign before the paint is dry
tracks.caption: Thai new wave hip-hop, mid-2020s Bangkok rap built on 1980s new wave, sung and rapped in Thai. A gated drum-machine snare with handclaps on every backbeat; a bright analog polysynth riff in staccato eighth notes; a rubbery synth bass line; chorused clean electric guitar chops; a tenor saxophone answering the chorus and taking an eight-bar solo in the bridge. Punchy, dry, retro-80s but clean modern mix. Female vocalist, mid register, fast conversational rap with crisp consonants in the verses, switching to a sung melodic chorus with a doubled harmony. 104 BPM, F# minor. Breathless, comic and rowdy. No trap hi-hat rolls, no 808 slides, no autotune, no EDM drop, no luk thung ornaments.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - gated drum machine, handclaps, bright synth riff]

[Verse 1]
บ่ายโมงตรง ทีมเปลี่ยนป้ายซอยเขตบางพลัดออกงาน
ฉันยืนท้ายรถกระบะ โทรโข่งสีเหลืองอยู่ในมือ
พี่เปี๊ยกถือสว่าน พี่หน่องแบกบันไดอะลูมิเนียม
ป้ายฟ้าซีดสิบสองแผ่น ต้องเปลี่ยนให้หมดก่อนห้าโมง

[Pre-Chorus]
หลบหน่อยค่ะ หลบหน่อยนะคะ
ป้ายเก่าลงก่อน ป้ายใหม่ขึ้นทีหลัง อย่ายืนใต้บันได

[Chorus]
ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว
น้ำเงินเข้มตัวขาวคมกริบ อ่านออกตั้งแต่ปากซอย
ปัง ปัง ปัง ป้าข้างบนเปิดบานเกล็ด
ตะโกนลงมาว่า สะกดผิดหนึ่งตัวนะหนู

[Verse 2]
เฮียร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวเดินถือนามบัตรออกมาเป็นกล่อง
พิมพ์ไว้สองพันใบ เลขซอยเก่าทุกใบเลยน้อง
ฉันกดโทรโข่งบอก ไม่ต้องห่วงค่ะเฮีย ไปรษณีย์ยังจำได้
เฮียไม่เชื่อ ยืนกอดกล่องจนพี่หน่องขันน็อตเสร็จ

[Chorus]
ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว
เด็กหัวเกรียนสามคนวิ่งตาม ยืนชูสองนิ้วใต้ป้าย
ปัง ปัง ปัง ป้าอีกหลังเปิดประตูใส่
ถามว่าป้ายเก่าทิ้งไหม เดี๋ยวป้าเอาไปปูกรงไก่

[Bridge - saxophone solo, then half-time]
แผ่นสุดท้ายปลายซอย สว่านแบตหมดพอดี
ทั้งซอยยืนรอดูพี่เปี๊ยกขันด้วยมือ เหมือนรอลุ้นจุดโทษ

[Chorus - full band, doubled vocals]
ป้ายใหม่มาแล้ว ครบทั้งซอยตอนห้าโมงห้า
ป้าคนเดิมเปิดพจนานุกรม ยอมรับว่าเราถูก
ปัง ปัง ปัง หน้าต่างทยอยเปิดทีละบาน
ป้ายื่นน้ำแดงลงมา บอกว่าเหนื่อยแย่เลยลูก

[Outro - synth riff and handclaps, sax answers, fade]

tracks.title: จิ้งหรีดไม่ยอมร้อง (Silent Crickets)
tracks.subject: a cricket farmer outside Khon Kaen whose forty concrete rings of crickets chirp all night every night, until the man from a Bangkok protein-snack company comes to inspect and every ring goes silent, until her husband plays his electric phin and they start up again
tracks.caption: Thai Afrobeat in the Afro Thai funk style: a Fela-style Afrobeat groove fused with Isan instruments, sung in Thai. A tight live drum kit with a busy hi-hat and syncopated kick; shekere and cowbell in a steady interlocking pattern; two clean electric guitars, one muted and scratchy, one repeating a short figure; a round fingered bass ostinato; a horn section of trumpet, tenor and baritone saxophone playing unison riffs and stabs; an electric phin playing a bright pentatonic lead, with a khaen holding drones in the breaks. Warm, live-room, slightly raw analog mix. Female lead vocal, mid register, playful talk-sung storytelling in the verses, call-and-response chorus with a group of backing singers. 112 BPM, D minor. Comic, sweaty and danceable. No trap drums, no EDM, no autotune, no amapiano log drums, no luk thung ballad strings.

A tight live drum kit with a busy hi-hat and syncopated kick; shekere and cowbell in a steady interlocking pattern; two clean electric guitars, one muted and scratchy, one repeating a short figure; a round fingered bass ostinato; a horn section of trumpet, tenor and baritone saxophone playing unison riffs and stabs; an electric phin playing a bright pentatonic lead, with a khaen holding drones in the breaks. Warm, live-room, slightly raw analog mix. Female lead vocal, mid register, playful talk-sung storytelling in the verses, call-and-response chorus with a group of backing singers. 112 BPM, D minor. Comic, sweaty and danceable. No trap drums, no EDM, no autotune, no amapiano log drums, no luk thung ballad strings.

tracks.subject: a deaf sign-language teacher in Chiang Mai who watches her husband, a former student from her Saturday class at the public library, interpret the northern regional evening news in the small box in the bottom-right corner of the screen; at the end of every bulletin he touches his collar twice, their sign that he is coming home
tracks.caption: Chiang Mai dream pop in the style of the city's 2020s indie scene, sung in Thai. Two electric guitars drenched in reverb and slow chorus, one strumming open chords, one playing a high tremolo-picked melody; a soft analog synth pad; a round, melodic bass guitar; a gentle live drum kit with brushed snare in the verses opening to a steady straight beat; a glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody. Hazy, wide, reverb-heavy mix with the vocal kept close and clear. Female vocal, soft and breathy mid register, intimate and unhurried, with an airy harmony on the chorus. 84 BPM, D-flat major. Tender, warm and hushed. No trap beat, no EDM build, no autotune, no shoegaze wall of distortion, no R&B vocal runs.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - reverb-washed guitars and a soft synth pad]

[Verse 1]
หนึ่งทุ่มตรง ข่าวภาคค่ำ ทีวีบ้านเราเปิดไว้ไม่มีเสียง
คนอ่านข่าวขยับปากอยู่กลางจอ ฉันไม่เคยมองเขาสักครั้ง
ฉันมองกรอบเล็กๆ มุมขวาล่าง ผู้ชายเสื้อเชิ้ตสีดำ
มือคุณเล่าเรื่องน้ำมันขึ้นราคา เล่าเรื่องฝุ่นควันบนดอยสุเทพ

[Pre-Chorus]
ทั้งภาคเหนือได้ยินเสียงคนอ่านข่าว
มีแต่ฉันที่ฟังมือคุณ

[Chorus]
มุมขวาล่าง คุณอยู่ตรงนั้นทุกคืน
มือคุณเป็นของคนทั้งภาคเหนือ ครึ่งชั่วโมง
พอข่าวจบ คุณแตะปกเสื้อสองครั้ง
แค่นั้นเอง ฉันรู้ว่าคุณกำลังกลับบ้าน

[Verse 2]
เราเจอกันที่ห้องเรียนภาษามือ วันเสาร์ที่ห้องสมุดประชาชน
ฉันเป็นครู คุณเป็นนักเรียนที่สะกดชื่อฉันผิดอยู่สามอาทิตย์
คุณทำมือคำว่าเชียงใหม่กลับหัว ทั้งห้องหัวเราะกันเงียบๆ
วันนี้คุณแปลข่าวให้คนทั้งภาคเหนือ ไม่มีใครรู้เรื่องนั้นหรอก

[Chorus]
มุมขวาล่าง คุณอยู่ตรงนั้นทุกคืน
มือคุณเป็นของคนทั้งภาคเหนือ ครึ่งชั่วโมง
พอข่าวจบ คุณแตะปกเสื้อสองครั้ง
ฉันลุกไปเปิดไฟหน้าบ้านรอ

[Bridge - drums drop out, guitars and glockenspiel]
บางคืนข่าวมีแต่เรื่องหนักๆ มือคุณดูเหนื่อย
แต่สองครั้งที่ปกเสื้อ ไม่เคยขาดสักคืน

[Chorus - full band, airy harmony]
มุมขวาล่าง กรอบเล็กกว่าฝ่ามือฉัน
แต่ทั้งบ้านเราอยู่ในนั้น
พอข่าวจบ คุณแตะปกเสื้อสองครั้ง
ฉันแตะจอตอบ แล้วไปเปิดประตูรอ

[Outro - guitars ring out, drums stop]

tracks.title: ซี่ลวดสามสิบหกซี่ (Thirty-Six Spokes)
tracks.genre: J-pop piano band rock (sung in Thai)
tracks.subject: a 19-year-old apprentice at an old Bangkok bicycle-repair shop rebuilding her first customer's rusted delivery bike spoke by spoke, watched by the shop owner, before the rider comes back to collect it at six
tracks.caption: J-pop piano band rock in the style of Official Hige Dandism, sung in Thai by a four-piece band led by grand piano. A bright grand piano playing fast syncopated chord riffs and runs; crunchy overdriven electric guitar with short funky fills; agile picked bass guitar with walking lines; live drums with a tight snare and four-on-the-floor lifts into each chorus; a tenor saxophone fill in the bridge. Clean, punchy modern band mix with the piano upfront. Male high tenor, bright and agile, quick wordy verses, a belted chorus with a falsetto flip, stacked band harmonies on the last chorus. 164 BPM, B-flat major. Cheerful and determined. No EDM drop, no trap beat, no autotune, no idol-pop synths, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bright piano riff with full band hits]

[Verse 1]
น้องฝนอายุสิบเก้า มาฝึกงานร้านผมได้สามเดือน
วันนี้ลูกค้าคนแรกของเธอ พี่ต้อมไรเดอร์ส่งข้าว
จักรยานสนิมขึ้นทั้งคัน ล้อหลังคดเป็นเลขแปด
พี่ต้อมบอกหกโมงเย็นมารับ พรุ่งนี้ต้องวิ่งงานแต่เช้า

[Pre-Chorus]
ผมยื่นประแจขันซี่ลวดให้ แล้วนั่งจิบกาแฟเย็น
เธอบอกว่าเฮียไม่ต้องช่วย นั่งดูเฉยๆ ก็พอ

[Chorus]
ซี่ลวดสามสิบหกซี่ ร้อยทีละซี่ไขว้กันไป
หมุนล้อฟังเสียงดังติ๊ง ตึงเท่ากันทุกซี่หรือยัง
ดุมเก่าล้างจนเห็นเหล็ก จาระบีเลอะถึงข้อศอก
หกโมงเย็นพี่ต้อมจะมา ล้อนี้ต้องหมุนตรง

[Verse 2]
บ่ายสองโมงเธอร้อยผิดข้าง ต้องรื้อออกครึ่งล้อ
ไม่บ่นสักคำ แค่ผูกผมใหม่ แล้วนั่งยองๆ ลงไปอีกรอบ
โซ่กินสนิมแช่น้ำมันไว้ เบรกหน้าเปลี่ยนยางใหม่
ตะกร้าหน้ารถบุบไปมุมหนึ่ง เธอเอาค้อนยางเคาะคืนรูป

[Chorus]
ซี่ลวดสามสิบหกซี่ ร้อยทีละซี่ไขว้กันไป
ยกล้อขึ้นแท่นตั้งศูนย์ ส่ายไปมิลเดียวก็ไม่ยอม
ดุมเก่าล้างจนเห็นเหล็ก เหงื่อหยดใส่แผ่นพื้นร้าน
ห้าโมงสี่สิบแล้วน้องฝน ล้อนี้ต้องหมุนตรง

[Bridge - piano breakdown, saxophone fill, band crashes back in]
หกโมงตรง พี่ต้อมเดินมาถึงหน้าร้าน
ปั่นวนรอบซอยหนึ่งรอบ แล้วกลับมาไม่พูดอะไร

[Chorus - stacked harmonies]
ซี่ลวดสามสิบหกซี่ หมุนเงียบจนได้ยินเสียงลม
พี่ต้อมจ่ายค่าซ่อมครบ แล้วยื่นแบงก์ร้อยให้เธออีกใบ
น้องฝนเก็บแบงก์ใบนั้น เหน็บไว้ข้างกระจกหลังร้าน
พรุ่งนี้ผมจะบอกเธอว่า คันต่อไปทำเองได้เลย

[Outro - piano riff, final band hit]

tracks.title: Câu Thơ Trong Vành Nón
tracks.subject: a man who crosses by boat to a Huế conical-hat maker's yard, orders a nón bài thơ and asks her to hide a line of poetry between the leaf layers of the brim; when he holds it up to the sun the cut-paper line is hers, not the verses he brought
tracks.caption: Vietnamese bossa nova pop in the soft mid-2020s V-pop album style. Nylon-string classical guitar playing a syncopated bossa comping pattern on jazz seventh and ninth chords; brushed snare and rim-click on a light bossa groove; warm upright bass walking in two; Rhodes electric piano answering the vocal phrases; a soft alto flute line in the intro and between verses. Dry, intimate close-mic mix with warm room reverb and light compression. Male light tenor vocal, breathy and conversational, near-whispered in the verses and a little brighter in the chorus. 124 BPM, D major. Tender, shy and smiling. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no autotune, no rap, no big ballad belting.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and alto flute]

[Verse 1]
Qua đò sang Tây Hồ, anh tìm nhà em làm nón
Mười sáu vành tre chuốt, lá phơi trắng cả sân
Anh đặt một chiếc nón, xin em lồng câu thơ
Câu nào em chọn cũng được, miễn đừng ai biết là anh xin

[Pre-Chorus]
Em cười, tay xỏ chỉ: "Hai tuần nữa anh quay lại"
Anh về đếm từng ngày như đếm vành nón tre

[Chorus]
Giơ nón lên trời nắng, câu thơ hiện ra
Nét chữ nằm giữa hai lớp lá mỏng
Anh đọc mãi mới hay, chẳng phải thơ anh
Là câu của em, giơ lên nắng mới thấy

[Verse 2]
Anh chép sẵn Hàn Mặc Tử, chép cả mấy câu ca dao
Em gấp tờ giấy lại, nhét vào túi áo anh
Trong nón em cắt chữ: "Người mua nón, nhớ quay lại"
Anh đứng giữa sân phơi, mặt đỏ như trưa hè

[Chorus]
Giơ nón lên trời nắng, câu thơ hiện ra
"Người mua nón, nhớ quay lại", em cắt nhỏ thôi
Anh đọc ba lần rồi, vẫn chưa dám hỏi
Là câu của em, giơ lên nắng mới thấy

[Bridge - Rhodes and guitar, half-time]
Chiều nay anh qua đò, không đặt thêm chiếc nón nào
Chỉ mang theo một câu, viết vụng trên giấy học trò

[Chorus]
Giơ nón lên trời nắng, em đọc câu anh
Chữ anh hơi xiêu vẹo, em cũng chẳng chê
Em buộc quai nón lại, che nắng cho hai người
Là câu của hai đứa, giơ lên nắng mới thấy

[Outro - alto flute and guitar, fading]

tracks.title: Lớp Sơn Thứ Mười Một
tracks.subject: an apprentice in a Hạ Thái lacquer workshop wet-sanding and re-coating the same black tray for its eleventh layer while the boss taps out the layers on the bench like a DJ counting bars
tracks.caption: Vietnamese soulful piano house in the 2020s club-pop crossover style. Four-on-the-floor kick with open hi-hats on the offbeat and handclaps on two and four; bouncing 90s-style house piano stabs on minor seventh chords; a round Juno-style synth bassline; short brass-section stabs closing the chorus lines; a congas loop under the verses. Clean, warm club mix with sidechained pads and no harsh distortion. Female mezzo vocal, bright and full, spoken-sung comic delivery in the verses, an open belted chorus with gospel-tinged ad-libs. 124 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, dogged and danceable. No Vinahouse, no hardstyle bounce, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - house piano stabs and congas, short]

[Verse 1]
Sáng ra xưởng Hạ Thái, cái khay nằm chờ tôi
Lớp thứ mười đã khô, giờ mài cho thật phẳng
Nhúng nước, mài vòng tròn, tê từ cổ tay lên vai
Ông chủ đứng sau lưng, gõ lên bàn: "Một, hai, ba, bốn"

[Pre-Chorus]
Ông đếm lớp như DJ đếm từng ô nhịp
Thiếu một lớp thôi là hỏng cả bài nhé

[Chorus]
Lớp thứ mười một, quét lên, chờ khô
Mài xuống, mài xuống, rồi lại quét lên
Ông chủ hô "vào!", tôi quét đúng nhịp
Lớp thứ mười một, cho cái khay đen bóng

[Verse 2]
Bụi sơn bám đầy móng, về nhà mẹ tưởng tôi đi đào than
Tôi kể mẹ nghe xưởng mình như một sàn nhảy
Buồng ủ ẩm tối om, mười hai tiếng chờ khô
Sáng mai mở cửa ra, hồi hộp như chờ trống vào

[Chorus]
Lớp thứ mười một, quét lên, chờ khô
Mài xuống, mài xuống, nước chảy theo tay
Ông chủ gật đầu, gõ thêm một nhịp
Lớp thứ mười một, soi vào thấy mặt mình

[Bridge - piano breakdown and claps]
Một lớp, hai lớp, ông đếm không sai
Còn mười lớp nữa, tôi nhảy tới mai

[Chorus]
Lớp thứ mười hai, quét lên, chờ khô
Mài xuống, mài xuống, cả xưởng nhún theo
Ông chủ bật loa, ai cũng vỗ tay
Lớp thứ mười hai, cái khay đen bóng

[Outro - piano stabs, brass hit, kick drops out]

tracks.title: Gặt Cói Nga Sơn
tracks.genre: Thanh Hóa hò sông Mã folk-pop
tracks.mood: teasing, sun-baked and full of work energy
tracks.subject: a garment-factory worker home from Bắc Ninh for one week of the June sedge harvest in Nga Sơn, cutting cói with her aunt's women's team who call hò sông Mã lines to keep the sickles together and tease her blistered city hands until she calls a line back
tracks.caption: Vietnamese folk-pop built on hò sông Mã, the Thanh Hóa river boatmen's call-and-response. A lead caller answered in unison by a group of women on the 'dô ta' refrains; đàn nguyệt plucking a bright pentatonic riff; sáo trúc bamboo flute ornaments between lines; a wooden mõ and a small trống cơm drum marking the work stroke, with a modern acoustic drum kit and fingered electric bass underneath; light strummed acoustic guitar. Open, sunny live-room production with natural reverb and the folk instruments up front. Female lead vocal, bright chest-voice folk tone with ornamented slides, a chorus of village women answering her. 104 BPM, D major. Teasing, sun-baked and full of work energy. No EDM drop, no trap beat, no autotune, no rap, no ballad strings, no Vinahouse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - đàn nguyệt riff, women call "dô ta"]

[Verse 1]
Tháng Sáu về Nga Sơn, nắng đổ xuống ruộng cói
Dì đưa cái liềm cong, bảo "con cắt thử xem"
Tay quen bấm máy may trong xưởng ở Bắc Ninh
Cắt được ba bó, tay rộp, mấy cô cười ngặt nghẽo

[Pre-Chorus]
Dì cất giọng hò lên, cả đội cúi xuống theo
Liềm đưa một nhịp, cói ngã một hàng

[Chorus]
Dô ta, cắt cho đều tay
Cói xanh cao quá đầu, ngã xuống thơm mùi bùn
Dô ta, ai chậm là phải hò
Con gái thành phố ơi, hò một câu cho cả đội nghe

[Verse 2]
Trưa trải cói ra đường phơi, xe máy phải lách qua
Mấy cô hỏi "trên xưởng đã có anh nào chưa"
Tôi đỏ mặt cúi xuống, bó luôn một bó thật to
Lạt buộc lỏng tuột ra, cả ruộng lại cười một trận

[Chorus]
Dô ta, cắt cho đều tay
Nắng rát cả gáy, bùn ngập tới mắt cá chân
Dô ta, ai chậm là phải hò
Con gái từ Bắc Ninh về, hò thử một câu xem

[Bridge - women's chorus answering, sáo trúc]
Tôi hò một câu sai lời, cả ruộng cười nghiêng ngả
Dì hò lại câu ấy, tôi bắt được nhịp rồi

[Chorus]
Dô ta, cắt cho đều tay
Ngày thứ bảy, tay tôi chai đúng chỗ tay dì
Dô ta, tôi hò, cả đội đáp
Mai lên xe về xưởng, mang theo một chiếc chiếu hoa

[Outro - call and response, "dô ta", fading]

tracks.title: Bướm Đêm Tên Lớp Mình
tracks.subject: a Hanoi biology student on a summer moth survey in Hoàng Liên National Park who hangs a white sheet under a lamp every night, logs two hundred and twelve moths, and names the unidentified ones after her classmates in the class group chat, until her lecturer says the one named after Ngân may be a new species
tracks.caption: Vietnamese indie-pop with Northwest highland colour, in the mid-2020s Hanoi indie style. A H'Mông bamboo flute (sáo Mông) playing a bright, ornamented hook over the chorus; jangly clean electric guitar with a light chorus pedal; a buzzing đàn môi jaw harp as a rhythmic accent in the verses; bouncy fingered bass; tight indie drum kit with tambourine on the chorus. Warm, slightly roomy band mix, nothing glossy. Female alto-mezzo vocal, playful and wry, half-spoken in the verses, then a sing-along chorus with doubled harmonies from a small group. 118 BPM, E major. Nerdy, giddy and outdoorsy. No EDM drop, no trap drums, no autotune, no ballad piano, no stadium reverb.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - sáo Mông hook and jangly guitar]

[Verse 1]
Mười giờ đêm ở trạm kiểm lâm, tôi căng tấm ga trắng
Treo bóng đèn cao áp lên, rồi ngồi chờ khách tới
Con đầu tiên to bằng bàn tay, trên cánh có hai con mắt
Tới khuya, con thứ một trăm lẻ ba đậu ngay sống mũi tôi

[Pre-Chorus]
Sách định loại không có tên, thầy bảo "đặt tạm cũng được"
Thế là tôi mở danh sách lớp K68 ra

[Chorus]
Con này tên Tuấn, bay vòng vòng không chịu đậu
Con kia là Ngân, đen nhánh, ngồi im như đang thi
Ba trăm cây số xa Hà Nội
Mà đêm nào cả lớp cũng lên thăm tôi

[Verse 2]
Sáng ra tôi chụp ảnh, gửi vào nhóm lớp
"Ê Tuấn, râu mày dài bằng nửa người mày luôn"
Cả nhóm thả mặt cười, Ngân bảo "xóa đi"
Thầy thì nhắn riêng: "Con Ngân có khi là loài mới đó em"

[Chorus]
Con này tên Tuấn, bay vòng vòng không chịu đậu
Con kia là Ngân, giờ sắp lên tạp chí rồi
Ba trăm cây số xa Hà Nội
Ngân gọi điện la: "Sao không chọn con nào đẹp hơn cho tao"

[Bridge - đàn môi and flute duet]
Hai trăm mười hai con trong sổ, sáu con chưa có tên
Tôi để dành một con nâu nhạt cho cậu ngồi bàn đầu

[Chorus]
Con này tên Tuấn, con kia là Ngân
Còn con nâu nhạt nhút nhát kia, tôi chưa dám gọi tên
Ba trăm cây số xa Hà Nội
Đêm cuối tôi tắt đèn, thả cả lớp về rừng

[Outro - sáo Mông alone, then guitar ring-out]

tracks.title: Ba Trăm Mét Trước Bình Minh
tracks.subject: a Hanoi tree crew moving a century-old banyan overnight for a road widening, wrapping the root ball in burlap and wire and inching it 300 metres on a low trailer to its new pit before the first morning traffic
tracks.caption: Vietnamese-language liquid drum and bass in the style of the Saigon drum and bass club nights. Fast rolling breakbeat at double time with crisp ghost-note snares; deep warm sub-bass and a rounded reese bass moving under the chords; lush Rhodes electric piano chords; airy string pads; a muted guitar figure looping in the breakdown. Clean, wide, warm mix with a soft night-air reverb, never harsh. Male tenor vocal, soft and close, singing long legato lines in half-time over the fast drums, light falsetto on the chorus. 174 BPM, F minor. Patient, sleepless and quietly tender. No dubstep wobble, no neurofunk distortion, no EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no Vinahouse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords and string pad, breakbeat rolls in]

[Verse 1]
Mười giờ đêm, đầu phố chăng dây, cấm xe qua
Cây đa trăm tuổi đứng chờ, rễ ôm cả góc đường
Mình quấn bầu rễ bằng bao tải, rồi buộc lưới thép
Cần cẩu nhấc lên một chút, cả tổ nín thở

[Pre-Chorus]
Ông Tư vỗ vào thân cây, nói khẽ thôi
"Đi chậm thôi nhé, đừng sợ, có bọn tôi"

[Chorus]
Ba trăm mét, từng mét một
Trước khi trời sáng, mình đưa cây qua đường
Ai cũng mỏi rồi, chẳng ai muốn về
Ba trăm mét, đi chậm thôi

[Verse 2]
Hai giờ sáng, xe kéo nhích từng gang tay trên đường nhựa
Chim trong tán giật mình, rồi lại đậu xuống cành
Anh bảo vệ đầu ngõ đứng nhìn, tay cầm cái quạt
Hỏi "có sống được không", tôi gật đầu, chưa chắc

[Chorus]
Ba trăm mét, từng mét một
Bầu rễ còn ướt, mình tưới thêm nước
Đèn đường vàng vọt, lá rụng đầy vai
Ba trăm mét, còn chút nữa thôi

[Bridge - half-time, Rhodes and voice]
Năm giờ, cây đứng vào hố mới, đất lấp quanh chân
Ông Tư ngồi bệt xuống, châm điếu thuốc, không nói gì

[Chorus]
Ba trăm mét, đi hết rồi
Trời vừa sáng, chiếc xe đầu tiên chạy qua
Chẳng ai biết đêm qua cây vừa chuyển nhà
Ba trăm mét, ngủ ngon nhé

[Outro - breakbeat drops out, Rhodes alone]

tracks.title: 大帽山結霜啦
tracks.subject: the January night Hong Kong chased frost up Tai Mo Shan: minibus queues stretching down the street outside Tsuen Wan station, crowds walking the last half of the road wrapped in bedsheets, a stranger pouring hot tea from a flask, and a secondary-school boy at the summit filming ice growing along a fence wire while everyone around him goes quiet
tracks.caption: Cantonese-language Jersey club, Newark club-dance style. Rapid Jersey club kick triplets bouncing under every bar, a squeaking bed-spring percussion loop, chopped snare rolls into each chorus, bright staccato synth stabs, and a round sub bass. Crisp, punchy club mix with dry kicks upfront, a bright top end and a tight sub. Female Cantonese lead with a light, playful mid-register voice, half-spoken in the verses and sung in the chorus, a few male voices answering the hook. 140 BPM, F minor. Giddy, bouncy and wide-eyed. No trap hi-hats, no EDM build or drop, no house four-on-the-floor, no UK garage shuffle, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
天文台話今晚 跌到零度
全香港即刻 衝上大帽山
荃灣站門口 小巴排咗三條街
人人揹住張被單 好似去露營

[Pre-Chorus]
司機話上到一半 就要落車自己行
我哋話得 得 行上去都得

[Chorus]
結霜啦 結霜啦 大帽山結霜啦
裹住張被 一步一滑 都要上
凍到鼻哥紅晒 都要望一望
結霜啦 結霜啦 香港都有霜

[Verse]
半山條路 塞滿晒的士私家車
有個阿叔著短褲 拖鞋踩住冰
有個姐姐 揸住暖水壺派熱茶
我借咗佢條頸巾 佢話唔使還

[Pre-Chorus]
越行越凍 一開口就出白煙
大家笑住講 似唔似北海道

[Chorus]
結霜啦 結霜啦 大帽山結霜啦
被單搭頭 成隊人好似一串糉
手指凍到僵晒 都要影
結霜啦 結霜啦 香港都有霜

[Verse]
去到山頂 鐵絲網一條條白晒
有個中學生 部手機貼住條鐵絲
佢影住一粒冰 喺條線上面慢慢生大
成班人圍埋佢 唔敢出聲

[Bridge]
天光嗰陣 佢叫我哋望落山
成個荃灣 喺雲底下著晒燈
佢話今日唔返學 阿Sir會唔會明

[Chorus]
結霜啦 結霜啦 大帽山結霜啦
被單凍到硬晒 摺唔返埋
落山條隊 仲長過上山
結霜啦 結霜啦 我見過香港嘅霜

[Outro]
結霜啦 結霜啦

tracks.title: 淋水嗰個
tracks.subject: a couple renting a hundred-square-foot plot at a weekend leisure farm in Kam Tin for a year, where she does the watering and he picks off the caterpillars and snails, and in August he leaves the first red tomato for her to pick
tracks.caption: Cantonese-language Ghanaian guitar-band highlife, 1970s Cape Coast style. Two clean electric guitars weaving bright interlocking palm-wine-style lines, a round melodic electric bass, congas and a steady gankogui bell pattern, a light trap kit with rim clicks, and a soft two-trumpet horn line answering between phrases. Warm, airy band recording with the guitars upfront and sweet. Male Cantonese lead with a warm, plain tenor voice, a female voice joining in close high harmony on the choruses. 104 BPM, G major. Warm, teasing and quietly devoted. No accordion, no Latin percussion, no banjo, no fiddle, no Afrobeats or amapiano drums, no synths, no autotune, no pop production.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
錦田嗰塊田 我哋租咗一年
逢禮拜日 西鐵轉小巴 再行廿分鐘
你頂草帽大到 我睇唔到你塊面
我孭住包肥料 你揸住一包蕃茄種

[Pre-Chorus]
你話你淋水 我負責捉蟲
我話好 咁我哋就分工

[Chorus]
你係淋水嗰個 我係捉蟲嗰個
一人一隻手套 一人一條田基
你淋到成塊田 變晒泥漿
我都唔講 我淨係鍾意睇你淋

[Verse]
六月啲菜蟲 食到啲葉成個窿
我一條一條夾走 放返落隔籬草叢
你喺水喉度跳起 叫話有隻蝸牛
其實係你淋得多 先引佢上嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
你話唔關我事 係佢自己嚟
我話係係係 係佢自己嚟

[Chorus]
你係淋水嗰個 我係捉蟲嗰個
一人一隻手套 一人一條田基
蝸牛又返嚟 你又扮唔知
我捉完一隻 又望多你一次

[Verse]
八月頭一棚蕃茄 青青黃黃
得一粒係紅 細細粒掛喺最底
你蹲低咗好耐 都唔捨得摘
我話摘啦 嗰粒我一早留咗畀你

[Bridge]
明年張租約 我已經簽咗
多加一行通菜 你話你鍾意食
你淋水 我捉蟲 仲有好多個禮拜日

[Chorus]
你係淋水嗰個 我係捉蟲嗰個
一人一隻手套 一人一條田基
淋多少少 都冇所謂
最紅嗰粒 年年都係你嘅

[Outro]
你淋水 我捉蟲

tracks.title: 開鎖佬
tracks.subject: a 24-hour locksmith in Kwun Tong on one night's calls: he refuses to open the door for a drunk young man whose girlfriend has locked him out, frees an old woman's cat that shut itself in her bathroom, and at dawn finds he has lost his own keys and has to call his apprentice, who charges him the full fee
tracks.caption: Cantonese-language corridos tumbados, modern Mexican street-corrido style. A requinto guitar playing fast tremolo runs and trills between every vocal line, a twelve-string bajo quinto strumming tight syncopated chords, a tololoche upright bass slapped on the beat, and a light charcheta sousaphone doubling the bass in the choruses. Intimate, dry live-band recording with the guitars upfront and a warm low end. Male Cantonese lead with a nasal, laid-back baritone, telling the story in a half-sung storyteller delivery with a slight drawl. 138 BPM, A minor. Deadpan, swaggering and tongue-in-cheek. No trap hi-hats, no 808s, no reggaeton beat, no mariachi trumpets, no banda brass section, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
觀塘有個開鎖佬 人人叫佢陳師傅
一個工具袋 一支電筒 廿四個鐘都接
冇門佢開唔到 冇鎖佢唔識
一條鐵線 十秒 你屋企道門就開

[Pre-Chorus]
半夜三點 電話一響
佢落樓 對拖鞋都唔換

[Chorus]
開鎖佬 開鎖佬 陳師傅嚟到
十秒開門 收你六百
唔使多謝 唔使解釋
下次記得 鎖匙放褲袋

[Verse]
第一單牛頭角 有個後生仔飲醉
著住對襪 坐喺門口地下
話女朋友喺入面 點都唔肯開
陳師傅望一望 話呢單我唔做

[Pre-Chorus]
後生仔話 我畀雙倍
陳師傅話 你同佢講啦

[Chorus]
開鎖佬 開鎖佬 陳師傅嚟到
有啲門 唔係鐵線開得到
唔收你錢 送你一句
講聲對唔住 好過搵我

[Verse]
第二單秀茂坪 有個婆婆喊住打嚟
佢隻貓自己 閂埋咗廁所門
婆婆喺門口 叫咗佢成個鐘
陳師傅鐵線一撩 隻貓仲嬲佢嚟遲

[Bridge]
天光收工 返到自己舖頭
一摸褲袋 嗰串鎖匙唔見咗
開咗一世鎖嘅陳師傅 企喺閘口

[Chorus]
開鎖佬 開鎖佬 徒弟嚟到
十秒開閘 照收六百
仲拍拍佢膊頭 話師傅
下次記得 鎖匙放褲袋

[Outro]
觀塘開鎖佬 廿四個鐘都接
