tracks.title: 花生有人要咗
tracks.mood: bittersweet, earnest, glad and a little lost
tracks.subject: an office worker who has walked the same nine-year-old black shelter dog, Peanut, every Saturday for two years at a dog shelter in Sheung Shui, and arrives one Saturday to find her kennel empty because a family adopted her on Wednesday, so he walks a young brown dog called Tofu instead
tracks.caption: Cantonese-language Midwest emo, late-90s twinkly emo revival style. Two clean electric guitars in open tuning playing interlocking twinkly tapped arpeggios, a melodic electric bass moving under them, busy live drums with math-rock accents and stop-start fills, and a lone trumpet playing a simple line in the bridge. Bright, roomy, basement-recorded indie mix with the guitars ringing in light reverb, unpolished. Male Cantonese lead with an earnest, unpolished tenor that strains on the high notes, friends joining in gang vocals on the last chorus. 140 BPM, D major. Bittersweet and earnest, glad and a little lost. No pop-punk power chords, no screamed vocals, no synths, no trap drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
上水嗰間狗屋 禮拜六九點
我簽個名 攞條狗帶 行去第七格
花生已經企定 條尾搖到停唔到
佢全身黑色 九歲 個嘴白咗一半

[Pre-Chorus]
兩年嚟有人嚟睇 冇人揀佢
人哋話佢老 我話佢只係行得慢

[Chorus]
花生 行慢啲 唔緊要
梧桐河邊 行到第三支燈柱先返
你逐條草咁嗅 我等你
禮拜六 我淨係得你

[Verse]
今個禮拜六 我照舊九點到
第七格張毯摺好咗 個碗洗得好乾淨
姑娘行過嚟 笑住同我講
花生禮拜三 有人要咗

[Pre-Chorus]
一家四口 個細路一眼揀中佢
話佢最乖 唔搶嘢食

[Chorus]
花生 行慢啲 唔緊要
你新屋企 有個露台曬到太陽
你逐條草咁嗅 有人等你
禮拜六 我揸住一條空狗帶

[Verse]
姑娘話 不如你行下其他嗰啲
第十二格有隻啡色 叫做豆腐
佢一見我 成個撲埋嚟
扯住我向前衝 一步都冇停過

[Bridge]
我好開心 我真係好開心
只係梧桐河邊 第三支燈柱
今日我冇停低

[Chorus]
豆腐 行慢啲 唔緊要
梧桐河邊 行到第三支燈柱先返
你逐條草咁嗅 我等你
花生 你喺新屋企 都要行慢啲

[Outro]
禮拜六九點 我會再嚟

tracks.title: 牛呀牛讓一讓
tracks.subject: a Lantau cattle volunteer at eight on a weekday morning on South Lantau Road, coaxing a dozen feral cattle off the white line with a flag and a whistle while three buses, a lorry and a taxi wait; the lead cow Ah Fa chews slowly at her before moving, a new calf hesitates beside its mother, and the first bus driver leans out to promise her a bun tomorrow
tracks.caption: Cantonese-language jump swing, lindy-hop dance-band style. A walking upright bass, swing drums riding the ride cymbal with snare kicks and a backbeat on the hi-hat, a stride piano comping and taking short fills, a tight horn section of trumpet, trombone and tenor saxophone playing riffing shout choruses, and a muted trumpet answering the vocal. Punchy live dance-hall swing mix with the horns upfront, roomy but tight. Female Cantonese lead with a bright, brassy alto and crisp rhythmic phrasing, the band shouting the hook back. 172 BPM, B-flat major. Brassy, bustling, cheeky and kind. No electro-swing beats, no programmed drums, no rock guitar, no pop production, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
朝早八點 嶼南道 長沙出梅窩嗰段
十幾隻黃牛 企喺馬路中間唔郁
後面三架巴士 一架貨車 一架的士
我揸住支旗 吹住個銀雞跑出嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
我叫佢哋大姐 我叫佢哋大佬
唔該行入啲 人哋要返工

[Chorus]
牛呀牛 讓一讓 讓一讓
吹一吹銀雞 搖一搖支旗
巴士司機揮揮手 等埋你
牛呀牛 讓一讓 今朝要返工

[Verse]
帶頭嗰隻 我哋叫佢阿花
佢肯郁 成隊都會跟住佢行
但係佢今朝 專登望住我 慢慢嚼草
嚼完一啖 又企返喺白線上面

[Pre-Chorus]
我摸摸佢條頸 同佢講聲早晨
佢擰一擰頭 終於行咗一步

[Chorus]
牛呀牛 讓一讓 行多一步
吹一吹銀雞 搖一搖支旗
巴士司機響一響號 笑住等
牛呀牛 讓一讓 阿花帶路

[Verse]
最後一隻 係今年先出世嘅牛仔
企喺路邊 唔肯離開佢阿媽
阿媽行落草地 佢先跳兩跳跟住
三架巴士 一架一架 慢慢開走

[Bridge]
第一架嗰個司機 開窗叫我一聲
問我聽日幾點 我話八點
佢話好 聽日帶個菠蘿包畀你

[Chorus]
牛呀牛 讓一讓 聽日見
吹一吹銀雞 收埋支旗
成條嶼南道 終於郁得
牛呀牛 讓一讓 聽日八點見

[Outro]
牛呀牛 讓一讓

tracks.title: 借過借過
tracks.subject: an overnight porter at a taichung hospital pushing beds, wheelchairs and specimen boxes twenty thousand steps a night, shouting 'excuse me' at every corner, and the grandmother on her way to a two a.m. x-ray who tells him to push faster
tracks.caption: Salsa dura in the New York-Puerto Rican style, sung in Mandarin with coro-pregon call-and-response. Two trombones in tight harmony blasting a mambo section; a montuno piano repeating a syncopated two-bar figure locked to the clave; congas playing tumbao with sharp slaps; timbales riding cascara on the shell with a cowbell on the downbeat; deep tumbao on an electric baby bass. Live-room recording, horns up front, dry and punchy, no reverb wash. Male tenor sonero lead, bright and slightly nasal, quick-witted ad-libs, a small male coro answering every line of the hook. 180 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, sweaty, fast-moving night shift. No reggaeton dembow, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no pop ballad strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - timbales roll, trombone mambo riff, piano montuno]

[Verse 1]
晚上十點 換上綠色的制服
對講機在腰上 一直喊我的名字
七樓要一張床 五樓要一台輪椅
三號電梯 又停在地下室

[Pre-Chorus]
球鞋的鞋底 快要磨穿了
計步器說 今晚兩萬三

[Chorus]
借過 借過 床來了
轉彎 不要撞到牆
護理站在喊 阿傑快一點
整張床跟著我 在走廊轉一圈

[Verse 2]
凌晨兩點 推一位阿嬤去照X光
她抓著欄杆說 年輕人你推太慢
我說阿嬤坐好 前面要轉彎了
她笑到點滴架 跟著一起搖

[Chorus]
借過 借過 床來了
轉彎 不要撞到牆
阿嬤在後面喊 再快一點
整張床跟著我 在走廊轉一圈

[Bridge - coro and pregon trade lines, trombones answer]
左轉檢驗科 右轉放射科
早上七點交班 我要一碗鹹粥

[Chorus]
借過 借過 天亮了
早班的人 從大門進來
阿嬤推回病房 她說明天見
我推著空床回去 還在數拍子

[Outro - montuno vamp, trombone shout, final timbales break]

tracks.title: 四十隻小羊
tracks.subject: a helper on a taitung dairy-goat farm in kidding season bottle-feeding forty kids at five in the morning, every one named after a colleague from his old office, and the bossy one named after his manager who keeps eating his straw hat
tracks.caption: Modern Nashville country pop sung in Mandarin, mid-2020s radio-country sound. A bright banjo rolling steady eighth notes; a twangy Telecaster with chicken-picking licks between vocal lines; a strummed steel-string acoustic; pedal steel swells under the chorus; a stomp-clap backbeat over a live kit and a warm round bass. Clean, wide, polished radio mix with the vocal dry and up front. Male baritone lead, easygoing and slightly gravelly, conversational with a grin, gang vocals joining on the last chorus. 112 BPM, G major. Sunny, teasing, early-morning farm work. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop, no Mandopop ballad strings, no Chinese folk instruments.

tracks.title: 替你繫的那一隻
tracks.subject: two volunteers at a dawn bird-ringing station on the Guandu wetland in autumn migration, weighing warblers in cloth bags; she fits the rings, he keeps the logbook and writes her initial beside every bird she rings, and on the last morning of the season she rings one and says it is for him
tracks.caption: 1970s Taiwan campus folk (xiaoyuan minge) revival, unplugged and earnest. Two fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitars in open interlocking parts; a soft harmonica answering the end of each verse line; a light upright bass walking under the chorus; a hand tambourine only on the last chorus. Plain close-miked recording in a small dry room, warm tape tone, no studio gloss. Clear young male tenor, plain and sincere, gentle straight-tone delivery, a soft female harmony joining on the last chorus. 84 BPM, D major. Shy, warm, hopeful. No drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no ballad string section, no R&B runs.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - two fingerpicked acoustic guitars, harmonica]

[Verse 1]
清晨五點 關渡的天還沒亮
網子上掛著 一身露水的柳鶯
你把牠輕輕 放進小布袋
秤一秤 九克半

[Pre-Chorus]
我在記錄本 寫下牠的翅長
再偷偷在旁邊 寫一個字

[Chorus]
每一隻你繫上腳環的鳥
我都在本子邊邊 寫一個芸
你問我 那個字是什麼記號
我說 是今天的風向

[Verse 2]
十月的北風 吹過紅樹林
你的手很穩 我的字有點抖
保溫瓶的咖啡 我們輪著喝
你說 牠們明天就要往南走

[Chorus]
每一隻你繫上腳環的鳥
我都在本子邊邊 寫一個芸
整本翻過去 密密麻麻
你終於笑著問 這陣風怎麼都不停

[Bridge]
這一季最後一個早晨
你從布袋裡 拿出一隻灰灰的小鳥
繫好腳環 放在我手心
你說 這一隻 是替你繫的

[Chorus - female harmony joins]
最後一隻你繫上腳環的鳥
你拿走我的筆 在旁邊寫字
不是芸 是我的名字
明年秋天 牠會回來 我們也還在這裡

[Outro - harmonica, last guitar chord rings]

tracks.title: 十一點五十的鐘聲
tracks.subject: the four-auntie kitchen team at a Tainan primary school cooking 1,200 lunches against the 11:50 bell: steamers stacked to the ceiling, ladles swinging in choreography, and one auntie shouting class numbers as the soup buckets roll out, until the bell rings and she finally sits down with her own bowl
tracks.caption: 1960s Motown-style soul sung in Mandarin, the Detroit sound as revived by Taiwan's R&B-funk-jazz bands. Tambourine and snare hitting every beat; a busy melodic electric bass in the Jamerson style; a chiming tremolo electric guitar; a stabbing horn section of trumpet, tenor sax and baritone sax; an upright piano pounding chords; a vibraphone tinkling over the chorus. Mono-leaning vintage mix, tight room, light tape saturation. Female alto lead, warm and gritty, punchy gospel-tinged phrasing, girl-group backing vocals answering each hook line. 126 BPM, B-flat major. Bustling, cheeky, racing the lunch bell. No trap drums, no autotune, no modern R&B runs, no synth bass, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tambourine and snare on every beat, horn stab, bass walk-up]

[Verse 1]
早上六點 台南的小學 廚房門打開
四個阿姨 圍裙一綁 蒸籠疊得比人還高
一千兩百份午餐 三杯雞配高麗菜
秀琴阿姨的大鍋鏟 炒得像在跳舞

[Pre-Chorus]
十一點五十 鐘聲就要響
誰都不准 慢半拍

[Chorus]
三年五班 湯桶好了沒
四年二班 白飯來了
阿姨喊一聲 鍋鏟轉一圈
鐘聲響以前 一桶都不能少

[Verse 2]
蒸籠一開 白煙衝上天花板
玉蘭阿姨打菜 每一勺都一樣多
小朋友趴在窗外 偷看今天吃什麼
阿姨說 吃光光 明天多一顆滷蛋

[Chorus]
六年一班 湯桶好了沒
一年三班 水果來了
阿姨喊一聲 鍋鏟轉一圈
鐘聲響以前 一桶都不能少

[Bridge - horns drop out, bass and handclaps]
十一點四十九 推車排成一列
四個阿姨 擦一擦汗 對看一眼

[Chorus - backing vocals full]
鐘聲響了 一千兩百份 全部到了
走廊上一千兩百聲 謝謝阿姨
秀琴把鍋鏟 靠在牆上
坐下來 吃她自己那一碗

[Outro - horns and tambourine vamp, cold stop]

tracks.title: 看鏡頭
tracks.subject: an immigration officer at counter four in taoyuan airport arrivals on the three-to-six a.m. shift, repeating 'look at the camera, left index finger, right index finger, next' to three hundred passengers off a bangkok red-eye, a man with his shoes on the wrong feet, a suitcase of dried mango, and a child making a peace sign at the camera
tracks.caption: Hard techno with a Mandarin vocal, the mid-2020s neo-rave sound of the Shanghai club scene. A distorted pounding kick drum on every beat with a rumbling tail; an acid TB-303 bassline squelching up through the filter; a metallic hoover synth stab on the hook; an open hi-hat on the offbeat; industrial clank percussion like a metal stamp on a desk. Dark warehouse mix, saturated low end, mono kick, everything compressed hard. Female mid-register vocal, deadpan and half-spoken, clipped and steady, doubled on the hook, no melisma. 150 BPM, F minor. Relentless, sleepless, deadpan-funny. No trap, no pop chorus melody, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop, no dubstep wobble.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - distorted kick alone, acid line rising through the filter]

[Verse 1]
凌晨三點 第四號櫃檯
曼谷的紅眼班機 剛剛落地
三百個人 從走廊湧過來
我的咖啡 已經涼了

[Pre-Chorus]
護照打開 放平
帽子 拿下來

[Chorus]
看鏡頭 看鏡頭
左手食指 按下去
右手食指 按下去
下一位

[Verse 2]
有人睡到 鞋子穿反
有人拖著 一整箱芒果乾
有個小孩 對著鏡頭比耶
我沒有笑 我真的沒有笑

[Chorus]
看鏡頭 看鏡頭
左手食指 按下去
小朋友 手放下來
下一位

[Bridge - kick drops out, acid line alone, then kick slams back]
五點四十 窗外開始亮
首爾 東京 胡志明
又一班 又一班

[Chorus]
看鏡頭 看鏡頭
右手食指 按下去
歡迎來到台灣
下一位

[Outro - kick and acid line, hoover stab, cut dead]
